cards.name: The Untamed Wilds
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of vengeance points in the victory display.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of locations in play (max 5).
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of cards in the exploration deck (max 5).
[elder_thing]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為勝利牌區內的復仇點數。
[cultist]：-X。其中X為場上的地點數(最多5)。
[tablet]：-X。其中X為探索牌堆內的卡牌數量(最多5)。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 higher than the number of vengeance points in the victory display.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of locations in play.
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of cards in the exploration deck (min 3).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead. If you are not poisoned and you fail, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為勝利牌區內的復仇點數+1。
[cultist]：-X。其中X為場上的地點數。
[tablet]：-X。其中X為探索牌堆內的卡牌數量(最少3)。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。如果你未中毒且檢定失敗，將放在一邊的1張中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。

cards.name: Expedition into the Wild
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Agents of Yig encounter set into the encounter deck.
Each investigator tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails performs the following, in order:
- If you are poisoned, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
- If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆和放在一邊的伊格的使徒遭遇組一同洗入遭遇牌堆。
每位調查員檢定[willpower](3)。檢定失敗的每位調查員依次執行以下流程：
- 如果你已中毒，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。
- 如果你未中毒，將放在一邊的1張中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。

cards.name: Intruders
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text: Each investigator is defeated. Each investigator who is not poisoned adds a set-aside Poisoned weakness to his or her deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 所有調查員被擊敗。每位未中毒的調查員將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡加入自己的牌組。

cards.name: Exploring the Rainforest
cards.text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at any non-[[Campsite]] locations may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在本輪結束時，任何位於非[[營地]]地點的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Ichtaca enemy into play at the lead investigator's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的伊塔卡敵人卡放置入場，放到調查員隊長所在地點。
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Huntress of the Eztli
cards.text: Objective - If Ichtaca is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Ichtaca, place her in the victory display and advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果伊塔卡被擊敗，推進場景。 目標 - 如果伊塔卡身上有1[per_investigator]線索，將她放入勝利牌區並推進。
cards.back_text:
If Ichtaca has 1 [per_investigator] clues on her:
"Interesting. You are not simply here to shed blood," Ichtaca says with a spark of wonder in her voice, and you are stunned to hear her speaking in perfect English.
Remember that "Ichtaca is leading the way." Add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3 - "Search for the Ruins."
If you defeated Ichtaca:
"Fools!" Ichtaca shouts to you with a pained voice. "You do not understand the forces you are meddling with. If you truly wish to die, you will find the temple over the river to the south."
Remember that "you fought with Ichtaca." Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Alejandro Vela asset. Add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3a - "The Guarded Ruins."
cards.back_text_cn:
如果伊塔卡身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：
"有趣，你不是為了流血來的。"伊塔卡語氣略帶驚訝，她完美的英語發音把你驚呆了。
請記住"伊塔卡在帶路"。將1個[cultist]標記加入混亂袋，持續到這個劇本結束。 將放在一邊的3張[[遺跡]]地點卡洗入探索牌堆，再推進到場景3a — "搜索遺跡"。
如果你擊敗了伊塔卡：
"蠢貨！"伊塔卡痛苦地朝你吼道，"你不知道自己干涉的是何方勢力。如果真的想找死，神廟就在河流南邊，走吧。"
請記住"你與伊塔卡發生了衝突"。選擇一位調查員來控制放在一邊的亞歷山卓·維拉支援卡。將1個[tablet]標記加入混亂袋，持續到這個劇本結束。 將放在一邊的3張[[遺跡]]地點卡洗入探索牌堆，再推進到場景3a — "守備森嚴的遺跡"。

cards.name: Search for the Ruins
cards.text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy cannot attack or be attacked. Ignore the effects of each Arrows from the Trees treachery. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個埃茲特里的守衛者敵人不能攻擊或被攻擊。忽略林中暗箭詭計卡的效果。 目標 - 只有在埃茲特里的遺跡的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: The Guarded Ruins
cards.text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Each Arrows from the Trees treachery gains surge. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個埃茲特里的守衛者敵人+1攻擊和+1躲避。每張林中暗箭詭計卡獲得湧動。 目標 - 只有在埃茲特里的遺跡的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: Expedition Camp
cards.text: [action]: Resign. The wilds are too dangerous! [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。荒野實在太危險了！ [action]：查看你們的補給品。如果你有地圖，查看探索牌堆頂上的3張卡牌。按任意順序將1張放在牌堆底，其餘2張放在牌堆頂。

cards.name: Alejandro Vela
cards.text:
You get +1 skill value while investigating an [[Ancient]] location.
[action] If you are at an [[Ancient]] location, exhaust Alejandro Vela: Draw 2 cards.
cards.text_cn:
調查[[古代]]地點時，你技能值+1。
[action]如果你位於[[古代]]地點，消耗亞歷山卓·維拉：抽取2張卡牌。

cards.name: Ichtaca
cards.text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Ichtaca you are not her enemy. If you succeed, place 1 clue on her. If you fail and Ichtaca is ready, she attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。反擊。 [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](4)來說服伊塔卡，你不是她的敵人。如果你成功，將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到伊塔卡上。如果你失敗，且伊塔卡處於準備狀態，則她攻擊你。

cards.name: Ruins of Eztli
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Ruins of Eztli: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你調查埃茲特里的遺跡時，技能檢定失敗後：抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。

cards.name: The Doom of Eztli
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1 (如果你所在地點有毀滅標記，改為-3)。
[cultist] [tablet]：-X。其中X為帶有毀滅標記的地點數。
[elder_thing]：再抽一個混亂標記。如果你失敗，將1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the total amount of doom on locations in play.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. Place 1 doom on your location.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2 (如果你所在地點有毀滅標記，改為-4)。
[cultist] [tablet]：-X。其中X為場上的地點帶有的毀滅標記總數。
[elder_thing]：再抽一個混亂標記。將1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。

cards.name: Something Stirs…
cards.text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
cards.text_cn: *本密謀的毀滅目標值+1[per_investigator]。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時：不要從場上任何地點移除毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Harbinger of Valusia at the location with the most doom.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的瓦盧西亞的預示者生成在場上毀滅標記最多的地點。

cards.name: The Temple Warden
cards.text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
cards.text_cn: *本密謀的毀滅目標值+1[per_investigator]。
cards.back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
cards.back_text_cn: 未撤退的所有調查員被擊敗。

cards.name: Into the Ruins
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck.
As you pass the strange glyphs in the walls, the ruins groan and creak in protest, and the carvings glow ominously. Years of deterioration have faded the pattern of these glyphs, and the surrounding stones seep with a venomous pus. If only you had some way to restore these glyphs…
Check your supplies. If any investigator has chalk, remove this act from the game. Otherwise, place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的時間石室地點洗入探索牌堆。
當你經過帶有古怪雕文的牆壁時，遺跡發出嘎吱嘎吱的聲音，以示反抗，雕刻也開始發光，預示不吉。這些雕文在多年的侵蝕之下圖形已漸漸消退，周圍的石塊滲出了濃稠的黏液。如果你有某些方法能夠保存這些雕文……
查看你的補給品。如果有任何調查員帶有粉筆，將本場景移出遊戲。否則，將本場景放入勝利牌區。本場景獲得復仇1。

cards.name: Magic and Science
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。 目標 - 只有在時間石室的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Move the placement of each location to form a straight line, with the Chamber of Time on the left and the Entryway on the right. Each other location is placed from left to right in between these two locations, in order of how much doom is on them, from lowest to highest (in the event of a tie, you may decide the order). Until the end of the scenario, ignore all location connections. Instead, each location is connected to each location to its left and right.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇位於時間石室的一位調查員來控制古代遺物。 將所有地點的擺放位置移動，擺成一條直線，時間石室在最左端，遺跡入口在最右端。其他所有地點從左到右擺放在這兩個地點之間，按照每個地點上的毀滅標記數從低到高進行排序(如果有多個地點的毀滅標記數相等，可以自行決定順序)。 在冒險結束之前，忽略所有地點之間的連接，改為每個地點與自己左邊和右邊的地點相互連接。

cards.name: Escape the Ruins
cards.text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 只要勝利牌區內有3點或更多的復仇點數，每個[[蛇族]]敵人+1躲避。 目標 - 如果所有未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If an investigator resigned with the Relic of Ages under his or her control:
The floor of the temple stops shaking, and the dull humming in the walls goes quiet. Without the relic in its chamber, the ruins appear to be sleeping once more. You still have no idea what the object is or what its purpose may be, but you dare not tarry any longer to find out.
(→R1)
Otherwise:
For a moment, the temple continues to shudder, the architecture twisting and contorting strangely. Pleased that it is once again whole, the temple then returns to its dormant state.
(→R3)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果控制著古代遺物支援卡的一位調查員撤退：
神廟的地面停止震動，牆壁沉悶的嗡嗡聲也停了下來。遺物離開原來的石室後，遺跡似乎再次陷入了沉睡。你還是不知道這到底是什麼東西，也不知道它的用途可能是什麼，但你不敢繼續在此逗留，沒工夫搞明白這一切。
(→結局1)
否則：
片刻後，神廟繼續劇烈地晃動，建築的結構開始異常地旋轉、扭曲。令人心安的是，神廟的整個結構再次組合在一起，然後再次陷入沉睡。
(→結局3)

cards.name: Entryway
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你暫時……逃出來了。 [action]：查看你們的補給品。如果你帶有火把，查看探索牌堆頂上的2張卡牌。將通過本效果查看到的所有詭計卡棄掉。混洗探索牌堆。

cards.name: Harbinger of Valusia
cards.text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Harbinger of Valusia can retaliate while exhausted. Forced - After Harbinger of Valusia is successfully attacked or evaded: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)
cards.text_cn: 警戒。獵手。反擊。 瓦盧西亞的預示者處於消耗狀態下仍可反擊。 強制 - 在成功攻擊或躲避瓦盧西亞的預示者後：在該卡牌上放置1資源。然後，如果該卡牌上有2[per_investigator]資源，瓦盧西亞的預示者發出奸險的嘶嘶聲並遁去身影。(將該卡牌放在一邊，視作在場外。該卡牌保留所有傷害標記。)

cards.name: Ancient Hall
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Flip 1 of the clues on Ancient Hall to its doom side. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：將古代石廳上的1個線索翻至毀滅標記面。在古代石廳的任意調查員可以花費3資源來取消此效果。

cards.name: Grand Chamber
cards.text: Forced - When you investigate Grand Chamber and do not succeed by at least 2: Before resolving any other effects from this skill test, flip 1 of the clues on Grand Chamber to its doom side.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你調查華美石室時，如果你未成功超過2點：在結算該次技能檢定的其他效果之前，將華美石室上的1個線索翻至毀滅標記面。

cards.name: Burial Pit
cards.text: Forced - After you put Burial Pit into play by exploring successfully: You must either draw 2 cards from the top of the encounter deck or place 2 doom on Burial Pit, or any combination thereof.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你探索成功並將坑葬墓室放置入場後：你必須從遭遇牌堆頂上抽取2張卡牌，或者將2個毀滅標記放在坑葬墓室上，或者上述兩項的任意組合。

cards.name: Underground Ruins
cards.text: While there is an enemy in Underground Ruins, Underground Ruins is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance). Forced - After an enemy in Underground Ruins leaves play: Place 1 doom on Underground Ruins.
cards.text_cn: 只要有敵人在地下遺跡，該地點卡視作在勝利牌區中(以計入復仇點數)。 強制 - 在地下遺跡中的敵人離場後：將1個毀滅標記放在地下遺跡上。

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Secret Passage: You must either take 1 horror and 1 damage, or place 1 doom on Secret Passage. Check your supplies. If you or an investigator at Secret Passage has a rope, ignore this effect.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入秘密通道後：你必須受到1點恐懼和1點傷害，或將1個毀滅標記放在秘密通道上。查看你們的補給品。如果你或一位調查員在秘密通道且帶有繩索，忽略此效果。

cards.name: Chamber of Time
cards.text: Forced - After Chamber of Time enters play: Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages asset to the Chamber of Time. Place 1 doom on Chamber of Time.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在時間石室入場後：將放在一邊的古代遺物支援卡疊加到時間石室。將1個毀滅標記放在時間石室上。

cards.name: Path of Thorns
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Path of Thorns: Take 1 damage. Forced - After you explore while at Path of Thorns, if the exploration was not successful: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你調查荊棘之路時，技能檢定失敗後：受到1點傷害。 強制 - 在你在荊棘之路探索失敗後：受到1點傷害。

cards.name: River Canyon
cards.text: [action]: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at River Canyon. Check your supplies. If you have a canteen, heal 2 additional damage. (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：位於河流峽谷的1位調查員治癒1點傷害。查看你的補給品。如果你帶有水壺，額外治癒2點傷害。(每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Rope Bridge
cards.text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Rope Bridge: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the exploration, take 2 damage, lose all remaining actions, and end your turn. Place your investigator in the River Canyon (if it is not in play, search the exploration deck for River Canyon and put it into play first; shuffle the exploration deck).
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於索橋並試圖探索時：檢定[agility](2)。如果你失敗，取消本次探索，受到2點傷害，失去所有剩餘的行動，然後結束回合。將你的調查員放在河流峽谷(如果該地點不在場上，查找探索牌堆，找出河流峽谷並將它放置入場；混洗探索牌堆)。

cards.name: Serpent's Haven
cards.text: Each [[Serpent]] enemy at Serpent's Haven gets +1 fight. Forced - After you investigate or explore while at Serpent's Haven, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 萬蛇據點的每個[[蛇族]]敵人+1攻擊。 強制 - 在你在萬蛇據點調查或探索後，如果你已中毒：受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Circuitous Trail
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to investigate or explore while at Circuitous Trail, check your supplies. If no investigator at your location has a compass, you must spend 3 resources.
cards.text_cn: 作為你在曲折小道調查或探索時的額外費用，查看你的補給品。如果你所在地點沒有調查員帶有指南針，你必須花費3資源。

cards.name: Temple of the Fang
cards.text: Temple of the Fang gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 勝利牌區內每有1點復仇點數，毒牙神廟+1隱藏值。

cards.name: Overgrown Ruins
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location, if you are poisoned: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入雜草叢生的遺跡後，如果你已中毒：失去所有剩餘的行動，然後結束你的回合。

cards.name: Overgrowth
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. You cannot explore at attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (4) to hack through the brush or [intellect] (4) to find another route. If you succeed, discard Overgrowth.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。每個地點限制1張。 你不能在本卡疊加的地點探索。 [action]：檢定[combat](4)來從灌木叢中闢出道路，或檢定[intellect](4)來另尋出路。如果你成功，丟棄瘋狂生長。

cards.name: Voice of the Jungle
cards.text: Revelation - Put Voice of the Jungle into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not successfully explore this turn: Take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Voice of the Jungle.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將叢林之聲放置到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 當你回合結束時，如果你本回合未探索成功：受到1點恐懼。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄叢林之聲。

cards.name: Pit Viper
cards.text: Forced - After Pit Viper deals you damage from its attack: If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在蝮蛇攻擊你並對你造成傷害後：如果你未中毒，將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。

cards.name: Boa Constrictor
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After Boa Constrictor attacks you: During the next upkeep phase, your exhausted cards cannot ready.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在蟒蛇攻擊你後：在下一個補給階段，你已消耗的卡牌不能準備。

cards.name: Snake Bite
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either (choose one): - Deal 5 damage to an [[Ally]] asset you control. - Take 1 direct damage. If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。如果你失敗，你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 對你控制的1張[[盟友]]支援卡造成5點傷害。 - 受到1點直接傷害。如果你未中毒，將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。

cards.name: Lost in the Wilds
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each point you fail by and add Lost in the Wilds to your threat area. You cannot move or explore. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Lost in the Wilds.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼，並且將迷失荒野加入你的威脅區域。 你不能移動或探索。 強制 - 當你回合結束時：丟棄迷失荒野。

cards.name: Low on Supplies
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Each investigator loses 2 resources. - Each investigator takes 1 damage. - Each investigator chooses and discards an asset he or she controls.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 每位調查員失去2資源。 - 每位調查員受到1點傷害。 - 每位調查員選擇並丟棄自己控制的1張支援卡。

cards.name: Brood of Yig
cards.text:
Hunter.
Brood of Yig gets +1 fight for each vengeance point in the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
勝利牌區內每有1點復仇點數，伊格之子+1攻擊。

cards.name: Serpent from Yoth
cards.text:
While there are 1 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains retaliate.
While there are 2 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth gains hunter.
While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, Serpent from Yoth takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it.
cards.text_cn:
勝利牌區內有1點或更多的復仇點數時，幽嘶蛇人獲得反擊。
勝利牌區內有2點或更多的復仇點數時，幽嘶蛇人獲得獵手。
勝利牌區內有3點或更多的復仇點數時，幽嘶蛇人每次受到攻擊時少受1點傷害。

cards.name: Curse of Yig
cards.text: Revelation - Put Curse of Yig into play in your threat area. You get -1 [combat], -1 health, and gain the [[Serpent]] trait. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you succeed, discard Curse of Yig.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將伊格的詛咒放置到你的威脅區域。 你獲得-1[combat]，生命值-1，並獲得[[蛇族]]屬性。 [action]：檢定[willpower](2)。勝利牌區內每有1點復仇點數，本次檢定難度+1。如果你成功，丟棄伊格的詛咒。

cards.name: Eztli Guardian
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location ([[Ancient]], if able). Alert. Aloof. Forced - When enemies attack during the enemy phase, if Eztli Guardian is ready and unengaged: It attacks each investigator in each connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個無人地點(如果可能的話，生成在[[古代]]地點)。 警戒。冷漠。 強制 - 在敵軍階段，敵人攻擊時，如果埃茲特里的守衛者已準備且未處於交戰狀態：則該敵人攻擊所有連接地點的所有調查員。

cards.name: Arrows from the Trees
cards.text: Revelation - Take 1 damage, plus 1 additional damage for each [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator at an [[Ancient]] location must also resolve that effect.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 -受到1點傷害，你每控制1張[[盟友]]支援卡，額外受到1點傷害。在[[古代]]地點上的其他所有調查員也必須結算此結果。

cards.name: Final Mistake
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each doom on your location. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](2)。你所在地點每有1個毀滅標記，本次檢定難度+1。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Entombed
cards.text: Revelation - Put Entombed into play in your threat area. You cannot disengage from enemies or move. [action]: Test [agility] (4) to escape the tomb or [combat] (4) to break out. If you succeed, discard Entombed. If you fail, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 until the end of the round.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將半身入土放置到你的威脅區域。 你不能與敵人解除交戰或移動。 [action]：檢定[agility](4)來逃出墓穴，或者檢定[combat](4)來掙脫束縛。如果你成功，丟棄半身入土。如果你失敗，將本檢定難度降低1點，直到本輪結束。

cards.name: A Tear in Time
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度一點，必須失去1次行動或受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Lost in Time
cards.text: Revelation - Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. If no asset is shuffled into your deck by this effect, choose and discard 3 cards from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將一張你控制的非劇情的支援卡洗回你的牌堆，將該支援卡上的所有傷害和恐懼移動到你的調查員上。如果沒有支援卡通過本效果洗入牌組，則選擇並丟棄你3張手牌。

cards.name: Ill Omen
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a location where there is at least 1 investigator. Place 1 doom on that location. Each investigator at the chosen location takes 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 選擇1個至少有1位調查員的地點。將1個毀滅標記放在該地點上。該地點上的每位調查員受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Ancestral Fear
cards.text: Peril. Surge. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on your location and discard Ancestral Fear (instead of placing it in the victory display). - Place Ancestral Fear in the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。湧動。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 在你所在地點放置1個毀滅標記，並丟棄先祖恐懼(而不是將它放入勝利牌區)。 - 將先祖恐懼放入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Deep Dark
cards.text: Revelation - Put Deep Dark into play next to the agenda deck. No more than 1 clue may be discovered from each location by each investigator each round. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Deep Dark from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將一片漆黑放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 每位調查員每輪不能從單個地點發現超過1個線索。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張一片漆黑。(每輪最多一次。)

cards.name: Brotherhood Cultist
cards.text: Hunter. Brotherhood Cultist gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each doom on it. Forced - When you initiate an attack against Brotherhood Cultist: Place 1 doom on Brotherhood Cultist.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 兄弟會邪教徒上每有一個毀滅標記，+1攻擊並+1躲避。 強制 - 在你對兄弟會邪教徒發動一次攻擊時：在兄弟會邪教徒上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Shadowed
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, take 1 horror and Shadowed gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to you. Place 1 doom on that enemy and test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果沒有[[異教徒]]敵人在場，受到1點恐懼，陰影籠罩獲得湧動。否則，找出離你最近的[[異教徒]]敵人。將1個毀滅標記放在該敵人上，然後檢定[willpower](X)，X為該敵人的攻擊值。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Words of Power
cards.text: Revelation - Put Words of Power into play in your threat area. If there are 1 or more enemies at your location with doom on them, you cannot damage those enemies or discover clues at your location. [action] [action]: Discard Words of Power.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將力量真言放置到你的威脅區域。 如果你所在地點有1名或多名敵人身上有毀滅標記，你不能對這些敵人造成傷害或發現你所在地點的線索。 [action][action]：丟棄力量真言。

cards.name: Fang of Yig
cards.text: Prey - Poisoned investigator. Retaliate. While Fang of Yig is engaged with a poisoned investigator, that investigator cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 中毒的調查員。 反擊。 伊格的獠牙與中毒的調查員交戰時，該調查員不能打出卡牌或在技能檢定中投入卡牌。

cards.name: Snakescourge
cards.text: Revelation - Put Snakescourge into play in your threat area. If you are poisoned, Snakescourge gains surge. Treat each of your non-weakness [[Item]] assets as if its text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Snakescourge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將毒蛇災厄放置到你的威脅區域。如果你已中毒，毒蛇災厄獲得湧動。 將所有的非弱點的[[道具]]支援卡的文本框視為空白([[屬性]]除外)。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：丟棄毒蛇災厄。

cards.name: Serpent's Call
cards.text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): Put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area, or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)：將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域，或抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的2張卡牌。

cards.name: Creeping Poison
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator who is poisoned takes 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 中毒的每位調查員受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Poisoned
cards.text: Limit 1 per investigator. Limit 1 per deck. Permanent. You are poisoned. (This has no game effect on its own. Other card effects may change or become stronger while you are poisoned.)
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員限制1張。每個牌組限制1張。 永久。 你中毒了。(這張卡牌本身沒有效果。你已中毒時，其他卡牌效果可能改變或增強。)

cards.name: Threads of Fate
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] : -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[cultist]] enemy.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on the nearest [[cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, lose 1 of your clues.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為帶有最多毀滅標記的[[異教徒]]敵人身上的毀滅標記數。
[cultist]：-2。如果你未成功並超過難度至少1點，受到1點傷害.
[tablet]：-2。如果你未成功並超過難度至少1點，在最近的[[異教徒]]敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你失敗，你失去一個線索。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull] : -X. X is the total number of doom in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, take 1 direct damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, place 1 doom on each [[cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, lose 1 of your clues.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為場上的毀滅標記總數。
[cultist]：-2。如果你未成功並超過難度至少2點，受到1點直接傷害。
[tablet]：-2。如果你未成功並超過難度至少2點，在每個[[異教徒]]敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，你失去一個線索。

cards.name: Three Fates
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你不想花費過多時間來冒險，因此你帶著蒐集到的信息安全返回。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If there are only 2 act decks in play, place 1 doom on agenda 2a as it is revealed.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果場上只有個2個場景牌堆，密謀2a被翻開時，在上面放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Behind the Curtain
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你不想花費過多時間來冒險，因此你帶著蒐集到的信息安全返回。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If there are only 2 act decks in play, place 1 doom on agenda 3a as it is revealed.
If there is only 1 act deck in play, place 2 doom on agenda 3a as it is revealed.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果場上只有個2個場景牌堆，密謀3a被翻開時，在上面放置1個毀滅標記。
如果場上只有個1個場景牌堆，密謀3a被翻開時，在上面放置2個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Hidden Entanglements
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你不想花費過多時間來冒險，因此你帶著蒐集到的信息安全返回。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 倖存的所有調查員被擊敗，並受到1點精神創傷。

cards.name: The Relic Is Missing!
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在米斯卡塔尼克大學的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: Harlan Is in Danger!
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Miskatonic University can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在米斯卡塔尼克大學的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: At the Exhibit
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在埃茲特里展廳的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play. If it was already in play, add add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it. Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Town Hall.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, add an additional 1 [per_investigator] clues to the Town Hall.
Advance to Act 3a - "Find the Relic."
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的市政廳地點放置入場。如果市政廳已在場上，在其上方放置1[per_investigator]個線索。將放在一邊的古代遺物疊加到市政廳。
如果場上有2個或更少的場景牌堆，在市政廳上放置額外1[per_investigator]個線索。
推進到場景3a - "尋找遺物"。

cards.name: At the Exhibit
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Eztli Exhibit can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在埃茲特里展廳的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for a Brotherhood Cultist and spawn it in the location farthest from all investigators. Heal all damage from each Brotherhood Cultist in play.
Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Brotherhood Cultist farthest from all investigators.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, add 1 doom to the Brotherhood Cultist with the attached Relic of Ages.
Advance to Act 3a - "Recover the Relic."
cards.back_text_cn:
查找遭遇牌堆、棄牌堆、勝利牌區，找出一張兄弟會邪教徒，將它生成在距離所有調查員最遠的地點。場上所有的兄弟會邪教徒治癒全部傷害。
將放在一邊的古代遺物支援卡疊加到距離所有調查員最遠的兄弟會邪教徒。
如果場上有2個或更少的場景牌堆，在疊加古代遺物的兄弟會邪教徒身上放置1個毀滅標記。
推進到場景3a - "奪回遺物"。

cards.name: Harlan's Curse
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果哈倫·恩斯通身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。
cards.back_text:
Attach the set-aside Relic of Ages to the Curiositie Shoppe.
If there are 2 or fewer act decks in play, search the encounter deck for 1 Acolyte (2 Acolytes instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Spawn each searched-for Acolyte in the Curiositie Shoppe.
Advance to Act 3a - "Find the Relic."
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的古代遺物支援卡疊加到珍品店。
如果場上有2個或更少的場景牌堆，查找遭遇牌堆的1張祭司(如果為3到4人遊戲，改為找出2張祭司)，將其生成在珍品店。
推進到場景3a - "尋找遺物"。

cards.name: Harlan's Curse
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Harlan Earnstone: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果哈倫·恩斯通身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。

cards.name: Find the Relic
cards.text: While Relic of Ages is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Relic of Ages is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: 古代遺物疊加到一個地點時，該地點隱藏值+2。 目標 - 如果古代遺物疊加的地點上沒有剩餘線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If the Relic of Ages is attached to the Town Hall:
After an hour of searching Arkham's Town Hall, you notice a faint blue glow emanating from underneath the door to the city planner's office. You break into the office without being noticed. The relic is lying on his desk, along with a map of the city that is covered in strange markings and iconography. Why is it here?
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If the Relic of Ages is attached to the Curiositie Shoppe:
Sure enough, the relic is tucked away in a corner of the shop's storage room, hidden from sight.
The investigator nearest to the Curiositie Shoppe takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果古代遺物疊加到市政廳：
在花費了一個小時來調查阿卡姆市政廳後，你注意到有一道微弱的藍光從一扇門底下透出，那是城市規劃師的辦公室。你闖進了這間辦公室，沒被任何人察覺。這件遺物就在他的桌子上，旁邊是一張本市的地圖，上面畫滿了古怪的標誌和圖形。它為什麼會在這兒？
距離市政廳最近的調查員控制古代遺物。將剩餘的"a/b"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果古代遺物疊加到珍品店：
果然，這件遺物就藏在珍品店儲物室的角落裡，避開了人們的視線。
距離珍品店最近的調查員控制古代遺物。將剩餘的"a/b"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Recover the Relic
cards.text: While Relic of Ages is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy the Relic of Ages is attached to leaves play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 古代遺物疊加到1個敵人時，該敵人生命值+2[per_investigator]。 目標 - 如果疊加了古代遺物的敵人離場，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If the Relic of Ages was attached to a Brotherhood Cultist:
As the robed figure collapses, the relic falls out of his cloak, clattering to the ground and rolling to a stop nearby. It is pulsing with an odd glow, as though aware it is being searched for.
The investigator nearest to the Brotherhood Cultist's location takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If the Relic of Ages was attached to Harlan Earnstone:
Harlan snaps out of his daze and collapses, holding his head in pain. "What was I - ?" His eyes widen as he realizes what he has done, and he pulls the relic out of his coat, offering it to you. "T-take it!" He says. "You can keep it safer than I can."
The investigator nearest to Harlan Earnstone's location takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果古代遺物疊加到兄弟會邪教徒：
隨著那個身著長袍的人影倒下，遺物從他的披風裡掉了出來，骨碌碌地掉到了地上，滾動了一小段距離就停下了。它一邊發出詭異的光芒一邊跳動著，彷彿它知道有人在尋找自己一般。
距離該兄弟會邪教徒所在地點最近的調查員控制古代遺物。將剩餘的"a/b"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果古代遺物疊加到哈倫·恩斯通：
哈倫從呆滯中恢復過來，癱倒在地，抱著他那頭痛欲裂的腦袋。"我這是怎——？"意識到自己幹了什麼後，他睜大了雙眼，從他的外套裡取出遺物，將它交給你。"拿、拿著它！"他說，"你比我更能保護它的安全。"
距離哈倫·恩斯通所在地點最近的調查員控制古代遺物。將剩餘的"a/b"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Search for Alejandro
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在東城區的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: Missing Persons
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Easttown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在東城區的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: At the Station
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在阿卡姆警察局的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Search all in- and out-of-play areas for a Hunting Nightgaunt and spawn it in the location farthest from all investigators. Heal all damage from each Hunting Nightgaunt in play.
Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to the Hunting Nightgaunt farthest from all investigators.
Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Plight."
cards.back_text_cn:
查找遭遇牌堆、棄牌堆、勝利牌區，找出1張狩獵中的夜魘，將它生成在距離所有調查員最遠的地點。場上所有狩獵中的夜魘治癒全部傷害。
將放在一邊的亞歷山卓·維拉疊加到距離所有調查員最遠的狩獵中的夜魘。
推進到場景3c - "亞歷山卓遇險"。

cards.name: At the Station
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Arkham Police Station can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在阿卡姆警察局的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: Friends in High Places
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果亨利·德沃身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play, if it is not already in play.
Attach the set-aside Alejandro Vela to the Town Hall.
Advance to Act 3c - "Alejandro's Prison."
cards.back_text_cn:
如果市政廳地點不在場上，將放在一邊的市政廳地點放置入場。
將放在一邊的亞歷山卓·維拉疊加到市政廳。
推進到場景3c - "亞歷山卓被關押"。

cards.name: Friends in High Places
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Henry Deveau: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果亨利·德沃身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。

cards.name: Alejandro's Prison
cards.text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to a location, that location gets +2 shroud. Objective - If Alejandro Vela is attached to a location with no remaining clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: 亞歷山卓·維拉疊加到一個地點時，該地點隱藏值+2。 目標 - 如果亞歷山卓·維拉疊加的地點上沒有剩餘線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If Alejandro Vela is attached to the Train Tracks:
After searching up and down for nearly an hour, you hear a voice coming from one of the storage cars. Sealed inside is Alejandro, murmuring to himself. "Thank goodness!" he exclaims as you enter. "I was just trying to figure out why they brought me here..."
The investigator nearest to the Train Tracks takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Alejandro Vela is attached to the Town Hall:
You manage to slip into the basement of the town hall without being spotted. You find Alejandro in one of the basement offices. He isn't restrained, but he is overjoyed to see you. "Thank goodness! They brought me here by force. Though I don't know why..."
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果亞歷山卓·維拉被疊加到火車軌道：
你四處尋找，花了快一個小時。你聽見從其中一輛貨運車廂傳來聲響。被鎖在裡面的正是喃喃自語的亞歷山卓。"謝天謝地！"在你走進車廂時他驚呼道，"我正想搞明白他們為什麼把我帶到這裡來呢……"
距離火車軌道最近的調查員控制亞歷山卓·維拉。將剩餘的"c/d"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果亞歷山卓·維拉被疊加到市政廳：
你成功潛入市政廳的地下層，沒被任何人發現。你在地下層的一個辦公室裡找到了亞歷山卓。他沒被限制自由，但他見了你便欣喜若狂："謝天謝地！他們強行把我帶到這裡來。但我不知道這是為什麼……"
距離市政廳最近的調查員控制亞歷山卓·維拉。將剩餘的"c/d"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Alejandro's Plight
cards.text: While Alejandro Vela is attached to an enemy, that enemy gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Objective - If the enemy Alejandro Vela is attached to leaves play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 亞歷山卓·維拉疊加到一個敵人時，該敵人生命值+2[per_investigator]。 目標 - 如果疊加了亞歷山卓·維拉的敵人離場，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If Alejandro Vela was attached to a Hunting Nightgaunt:
Alejandro collapses to the ground along with the winged creature's body. He coughs and rises to his feet, shaking. "Th-that beast! It had me in its clutches...Who knows where it was taking me?"
The investigator nearest to the Hunting Nightgaunt takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Alejandro Vela was attached to Henry Deveau:
Henry collapses to the ground, exhausted and bloodied. "Wait! I... I'll tell you where to find Alejandro!" He gives you an address in Rivertown, and you follow his directions. Inside the abandoned office building is Alejandro, not restrained but overjoyed to see you. "Thank goodness! You have to get me out of here!"
The investigator nearest to Henry Deveau takes control of Alejandro Vela. Remove the remainder of the "c/d" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果亞歷山卓·維拉被疊加到一個狩獵中的夜魘：
亞歷山卓和長著翅膀的生物的屍體一同落在地上。他咳嗽著，顫顫巍巍地站了起來。"那頭野獸！它用它的爪子抓著我……天知道它把我帶到哪裡去了！"
距離狩獵中的夜魘最近的調查員控制亞歷山卓·維拉。將剩餘的"c/d"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果亞歷山卓·維拉被疊加到亨利·德沃：
亨利癱倒在地，耗盡氣力，渾身是血。"慢著！我……我來告訴你上哪兒去找亞歷山卓！"他給了你一個在河岸城的地址，隨後你跟著他的指引，找到了那裡。就在一棟廢棄的辦公樓裡，你找到了亞歷山卓，他沒被限制自由，但他見了你便欣喜若狂："謝天謝地！你得帶我離開這兒！"
距離亨利·德沃最近的調查員控制亞歷山卓·維拉。將剩餘的"c/d"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Trial of the Huntress
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在河岸城的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: The Guardian's Inquiry
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在北區的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。

cards.name: The Cave of Darkness
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在幽暗洞穴的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。必須在幽暗洞穴沒有線索時才能推進本場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Cultist]] enemy is discarded (2 [[Cultist]] enemies instead if there are 2 or fewer act decks remaining). Spawn those enemies in Black Cave (instead of their normal spawn location). Until the end of the scenario, remember that those enemies are "Ichtaca's prey." Advance to Act 3e - "The Brotherhood Is Revealed."
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。從遭遇牌堆頂部棄牌，直到棄掉一個[[異教徒]]敵人(如果場上有2個或更少的場景牌堆，改為棄掉2個[[異教徒]]敵人)。 將這些敵人生成在幽暗洞穴(而不是其本來的生成地點)。在冒險結束之前，請記住這些敵人是"伊塔卡的獵物"。 推進到場景3e - "兄弟會暴露"。

cards.name: The Cave of Darkness
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Black Cave can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. There must be no clues remaining on the Black Cave in order to advance this act.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在幽暗洞穴的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。必須在幽暗洞穴沒有線索時才能推進本場景。
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Town Hall location into play, if it is not already in play. Remember that the Town Hall is "Ichtaca's destination." For the remainder of the game, Black Cave and Town Hall are connected to one another.
One at a time, in player order, each investigator discards the top card of the encounter deck. Each investigator who discards a treachery card must draw that card.
Advance to Act 3e - "Strange Occurrences."
cards.back_text_cn:
如果市政廳地點不在場上，將放在一邊的市政廳地點放置入場。請記住市政廳是"伊塔卡的目的地"。直到本局遊戲結束前，幽暗洞穴和市政廳相互連接。
按照玩家順序，每位調查員依次棄掉遭遇牌堆頂部的1張卡牌。所有棄掉詭計卡的調查員必須抽取該卡。
推進到場景3e - "怪事叢生"。

cards.name: Strange Relics
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果瑪利亞·德西瓦身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。

cards.name: Strange Relics
cards.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Maria DeSilva: You must remove them and immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果瑪利亞·德西瓦身上有1[per_investigator]個線索：你必須移除這些線索並且立即推進。
cards.back_text:
Remember that both Downtown and Rivertown are "Ichtaca's destinations."
One at a time, in player order, each investigator discards the top card of the encounter deck. Each investigator who discards a treachery card must draw that card.
Advance to Act 3e - "Strange Occurrences."
cards.back_text_cn:
請記住商業區和河岸城是"伊塔卡的目的地"。
按照玩家順序，每位調查員依次棄掉遭遇牌堆頂部的1張卡牌。所有棄掉詭計卡的調查員必須抽取該卡。
推進到場景3e - "怪事叢生"。

cards.name: Strange Occurrences
cards.text: While you are at any of "Ichtaca's destinations," the first treachery you draw from the encounter deck each round gains surge. Objective - If there are no clues remaining on each of "Ichtaca's destinations," advance.
cards.text_cn: 你位於"伊塔卡的目的地"時，你每輪從遭遇牌堆抽出的第一張詭計卡獲得湧動。 目標 - 如果所有"伊塔卡的目的地"均無線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If "Ichtaca's destination" was the Town Hall:
For some reason, the tunnels connect to a hidden passage in the basement of Arkham's town hall. You find Ichtaca in a dark room, browsing through several maps of the city. "What are you doing here?" she asks accusingly. "No matter. You're here now. Help me read these documents and figure out what is going on here."
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If "Ichtaca's destinations" were Downtown and Rivertown:
Using information from the bank, you track the bidders to a warehouse in Rivertown. Inside, you find a bounty of information about the Eztli relics and Alejandro's expedition.
The investigator nearest to Rivertown takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果市政廳是"伊塔卡的目的地"：
由於某些原因，這些隧道連通到阿卡姆市政廳地下層的一條密道。你在一個黑暗的房間裡找到伊塔卡，她正在瀏覽這座城市的幾張地圖。"你在這兒幹什麼？"她用責難的語氣問道，"算了，你都到這兒來了，就幫我讀讀這些文件，搞明白這兒發生了什麼。"
距離市政廳最近的調查員控制放在一邊的伊塔卡(失落的守衛者)。將剩餘的"e/f"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果商業區和河岸城是"伊塔卡的目的地"：
憑藉著從銀行取得的信息，你追蹤拍賣者來到了河岸城的一個倉庫。在這幢建築裡，你找到了更多的信息，關於埃茲特里遺物和亞歷山卓的探險隊。
距離河岸城最近的調查員控制放在一邊的伊塔卡(失落的守衛者)。將剩餘的"e/f"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: The Brotherhood Is Revealed
cards.text: "Ichtaca's prey" each get +1 fight, +1 [per_investigator] health, and +1 evade while at a location with no clues on it. Objective - If each of "Ichtaca's prey" is no longer in play, advance.
cards.text_cn: "伊塔卡的獵物"所在地點上如果沒有線索時，+1攻擊，+1[per_investigator]生命，+1躲避。 目標 - 如果所有"伊塔卡的獵物"均不在場上，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If "Ichtaca's prey" were 1 or more [[cultist]] enemies:
The final robed figure drops to the ground, and you breathe a sigh of relief. Ichtaca recovers her arrows and searches the bodies for clues. "Why did you follow me?" she asks accusingly. "No matter. What's done is done. Now to uncover what these cretins knew."
The investigator nearest to the Black Cave takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If "Ichtaca's prey" was Maria DeSilva:
You interrogate Maria while the angry Eztli warrior looms over her. "Who do you work for? What is your purpose?" Maria purses her lips tightly, then looks away, into the distance. "I'll tell you what you need to know. I'll tell you about the Brotherhood."
The investigator nearest to Maria DeSilva takes control of the set-aside Ichtaca (The Forgotten Guardian). Remove the remainder of the "e/f" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
如果"伊塔卡的獵物"是1個或多個[[異教徒]]敵人：
最後一個身著長袍的人摔倒在地，你放心地舒了一口氣。伊塔卡取回了她的箭枝，尋找線索。"你為什麼跟著我？"她用責難的語氣問道，"算了，都過去了。現在來看看這些瘋子都知道些什麼。"
距離幽暗洞穴最近的調查員控制放在一邊的伊塔卡(失落的守衛者)。將剩餘的"e/f"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。
如果"伊塔卡的獵物"是瑪利亞·德西瓦：
你質問瑪利亞的同時，憤怒的埃茲特里戰士也向她逼近。"你替誰辦事？你的目的又是什麼？"瑪利亞雙唇緊閉，然後目光看向遠方，"我會把你想要知道的都告訴你，關於兄弟會的一切。"
距離瑪利亞·德西瓦最近的調查員控制放在一邊的伊塔卡(失落的守衛者)。將剩餘的"e/f"場景牌堆移出遊戲。如果場上有另一張場景卡，繼續遊戲。否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Velma's Diner
cards.text:
Easttown is connected to Velma's Diner.
[action] [action] [action]: You kill some time at the diner and listen to the conversations of the patrons around you. Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn:
東城區與維爾瑪小餐館相互連接。
[action][action][action]：你在小餐館打發了些時間，聽著周圍顧客的交談。從供應堆獲得2個線索。(每場遊戲限制1次。)
cards.back_text: Easttown is connected to Velma's Diner.
cards.back_text_cn: 東城區與維爾瑪小餐館相互連接。

cards.name: Curiositie Shoppe
cards.text:
Northside is connected to Curiositie Shoppe.
While you are in the Curiositie Shoppe, reduce the cost of each [[relic]] asset you play by 2.
cards.text_cn:
北區與珍品店相互連接。
你位於珍品店時，你打出的每張[[遺物]]支援卡費用-2。
cards.back_text: Northside is connected to Curiositie Shoppe.
cards.back_text_cn: 北區與珍品店相互連接。

cards.name: Town Hall
cards.text: Downtown is connected to Town Hall. Forced - After you enter Town Hall, if you have 4 or more cards in your hand: Choose and discard cards from your hand until you have 3 cards in your hand.
cards.text_cn: 商業區與市政廳相互連接。 強制 - 在你進入市政廳後，如果你有4張或更多的手牌：選擇並丟棄手牌，直到你只有3張手牌。
cards.back_text: Downtown is connected to Town Hall.
cards.back_text_cn: 商業區與市政廳相互連接。

cards.name: The Secret Must Be Kept
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror. For each act deck the investigators have completed, this skill test gets +1 difficulty and deals +1 damage and +1 horror if it is failed.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害與1點恐懼。調查員每完成1個場景牌堆，該技能檢定+1難度，且檢定失敗造成的傷害和恐懼各+1。

cards.name: Nobody's Home
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. If there are no clues on your location, Nobody's Home gains surge. You must spend 1 additional action to investigate attached location. Forced - If there are no clues on attached location: Discard Nobody's Home.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。如果你所在地點沒有線索，屋中無人獲得湧動。 你必須額外花費1個行動來調查被疊加的地點。 強制 - 如果被疊加的地點沒有線索：丟棄屋中無人。

cards.name: Conspiracy of Blood
cards.text: Revelation - Attach Conspiracy of Blood to the current agenda. Attached agenda gets -1 doom threshold. Each [[cultist]] enemy gains: "[action] Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard 1 copy of Conspiracy of Blood from play. If you fail, place 1 doom on this enemy."
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將鮮血陰謀疊加到當前密謀卡。 被疊加的密謀卡的毀滅目標值-1。 每個[[異教徒]]敵人獲得："[action]：談判。檢定[willpower](4)。如果你成功，從場上丟棄1張鮮血陰謀。如果你失敗，在該敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。"

cards.name: Ichtaca
cards.text: You get +1 [combat] (+2 [combat] instead while attacking an enemy with Victory X). You get +1 [agility] (+2 [agility] instead while attempting to evade an enemy with Vengeance X). [reaction] After you add an enemy to the victory display, exhaust Ichtaca: You and Ichtaca each heal 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 你獲得+1[combat](攻擊帶有勝利X的敵人時，改為+2[combat])。 你獲得+1[agility](嘗試躲避帶有復仇X的敵人時，改為+2[agility])。 [reaction]在你將一個敵人加入勝利牌區後，消耗伊塔卡：你和伊塔卡各治癒1點恐懼。

cards.name: Expedition Journal
cards.text: You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to explore.
cards.text_cn: 在你回合中你可以進行額外一次行動，該行動只能用於探索。

cards.name: The Boundary Beyond
cards.text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Ancient]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail and there is a [[Serpent]] enemy at your location, it attacks you. [elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the nearest [[Ancient]] location.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-1(如果你位於[[古代]]地點，改為-3)。 [cultist]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，將1個毀滅標記放到1個[[異教徒]]敵人身上。 [tablet]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗且你所在地點有[[蛇族]]敵人，其中1個[[蛇族]]敵人攻擊你。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果你失敗，將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到最近的[[古代]]地點上。
cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at an [[Ancient]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location attacks you. [elder_thing]: -4. Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on the nearest [[Ancient]] location.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-2(如果你位於[[古代]]地點，改為-4)。 [cultist]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，在每個[[異教徒]]敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。 [tablet]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，你所在地點的所有[[蛇族]]敵人攻擊你。 [elder_thing]：-4。將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到最近的[[古代]]地點上。

cards.name: The Boundary, Broken
cards.back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
Following no telltale flash of light, a sudden explosion of thunder blasts across the sky, causing you to jump in shock. As though drawn from the sound, a streak of silver lightning crashes down from the clouds, ripping a tear in the world before you. Through this tear, a familiar creature emerges. It hisses in anger and raises its gilded spear to attack.
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 6 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
cards.back_text_cn:
查看冒險日誌。如果預示者還活著：
沒有任何閃光的徵兆，突然一道驚雷劃破天穹，把你嚇了一跳。一道銀色閃電彷彿伴隨著這聲巨響出現，從雲間落下，將你面前的世界撕開一條裂縫。在這條裂縫中，出現了一個熟悉的生物。它憤怒地發出嘶嘶聲，舉起鍍金長矛向你攻來。
搜索收藏，找出瓦盧西亞的預示者，將它生成在距離所有調查員最遠的地點(如果你冒險日誌裡的"伊格之怒"下方有6次或更多記錄，改為將它生成在調查員隊長所在地點)。按照冒險日誌括號內記錄的傷害總數，瓦盧西亞的預示者在入場時帶有對應數量的傷害。

cards.name: The Barrier Is Thin
cards.back_text:
Find each [[Tenochtitlán]] location in play with no clues on it. Add those locations to the victory display. Then, for each [[Present-Day]] location in play, search the exploration deck for a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner and place it on top of that location, taking its place.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Spawn the set-aside Padma Amrita enemy in Templo Mayor.
Remove the current act deck from the game. Put the set-aside act 3a and agenda 3a into play as the current act and agenda.
cards.back_text_cn:
找出場上所有不帶線索的[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點，將這些地點加入勝利牌區。然後，對場上每個[[現代]]地點分別執行以下流程：從探索牌堆中找出1張左上角帶有對應地點符號的地點卡，將找出的地點卡放在該地點上並取代該地點。
每位調查員失去自己的所有線索。
將放在一邊的帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔敵人生成在大神廟。
將當前場景牌堆移出遊戲。將放在一邊的場景3a和密謀3a放置入場，作為當前場景和密謀。

cards.name: Crossing the Threshold
cards.text: Objective - After the first [[Tenochtitlán]] location enters play by exploring successfully, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在通過成功探索第一次將[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點放置入場後，推進場景。
cards.back_text: The investigator who just put a [[Tenochtitlán]] location into play by exploring successfully must test [willpower] (4). If he or she fails, he or she must search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] or [[Injury]] weakness and shuffle it into his or her deck. (Note: Be aware that location connections are different on [[Tenochtitlán]] locations.)
cards.back_text_cn: 最近通過成功探索將1個[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點放置入場的調查員必須檢定[willpower](4)。如果失敗，該調查員必須從收藏中找出一張隨機的基礎[[瘋狂]]或[[損傷]]弱點，然後將它加入自己的牌組。 (注意：[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點的連接規則與其它地點不同。)

cards.name: Past and Present
cards.text: Objective - Find paths to the Nexus by discovering all of the clues from as many different [[Tenochtitlán]] locations as you can before time runs out. If there are 6 [[Tenochtitlán]] locations in play with no clues on them, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在時間耗盡之前，盡可能多地發現不同的[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點的所有線索，從而找到通往聯結點的道路。如果場上有6個[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點上沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Add each [[Tenochtitlán]] location in play to the victory display. Then, for each [[Present-Day]] location in play, search the exploration deck for a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner and place it on top of that location, taking its place.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Spawn the set-aside Padma Amrita enemy in Templo Mayor.
Remove the current agenda deck from the game. Put the set-aside act 3a and agenda 3a into play as the current act and agenda.
cards.back_text_cn:
將場上所有[[特諾奇蒂特蘭]]地點加入勝利牌區。然後，場上每有1張[[現代]]地點，就從探索牌堆中找出1張左上角帶有對應地點符號的地點卡，將找出的地點卡放在該地點上並取代該地點。
每位調查員失去自己的所有線索。
將放在一邊的帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔敵人生成在大神廟。
將當前密謀牌堆移出遊戲。將放在一邊的場景3a和密謀3a放置入場，作為當前場景和密謀。

cards.name: The Return Trip
cards.text: Objective - If Padma Amrita is defeated, advance. Objective - If investigators in Templo Mayor spend the requisite number of clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔被擊敗，推進場景。 目標 - 如果調查員在大神廟花費所需數量的線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If Padma Amrita was defeated:
"No! You fools!" Padma drops to her knees, bleeding out from her wounds. She looks up into Ichtaca's eyes, pleading with her. "How could you - ?" She is about to say something else when Ichtaca silences her with an arrow fired into her lung. "Go," says Ichtaca. "I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
If the investigators spent clues to advance:
"No! Come back here!" Padma screams as soon as she figures out your plan. "You can't leave me here! I have been chosen!" Ichtaca looks back at her with a pitying glance. The two of them share a knowing look for a short moment, and you hear Padma cry, "How could you?" Ichtaca pays her no heed, turning back to face you. "Go. I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔被擊敗：
"不！你們這些蠢貨！"帕德瑪雙膝跪倒，身上各處傷口淌著鮮血。她仰頭看向伊塔卡的雙眼，字字懇切："你怎麼能——？"他正想繼續說下去，伊塔卡一箭射穿了她的肺部，讓她再也說不出話。"走吧，"伊塔卡說道，"我會跟在你後面。"你揮去心中的恐懼，邁進裂縫。
(→結局1)
如果調查員花費線索來推進：
"不！回到這兒來！"帕德瑪知道你的計劃後尖叫道，"你不能把我留在這兒！我是被選中的人！"伊塔卡回頭看了她一眼，向她投以憐憫的目光。在短暫的片刻中，她們二人交換了眼色，然後你聽見帕德瑪哭喊："你怎麼能這樣？"伊塔卡不理會她，轉身面向你。"走吧。我會跟在你後面。"你揮去心中的恐懼，邁向裂縫。
(→結局1)

cards.name: Temple Ruins
cards.text: [action] [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Metropolitan Cathedral
cards.text: [action] Take 1 horror: Draw 2 cards. [action] If you have 6 or more cards in your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: [action]受到1點恐懼：抽取2張卡牌。 [action]如果你手牌有至少6張：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Chapultepec Park
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a [willpower] test while at Chapultepec Park: Take 1 horror. [action]: Explore. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於查普爾特佩克公園時，[willpower]技能檢定失敗後：受到1點恐懼。 [action]：探索。檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Zócalo
cards.text: [action] Discard cards with a total combined cost of at least 5 from your hand: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: [action]丟棄費用合計至少為5的手牌：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Xochimilco
cards.text: While you are at Xochimilco, you cannot gain resources. [action] Spend 3 resources: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: 你位於霍奇米爾科時，你不能獲得資源。 [action]花費3資源：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Coyoacán
cards.text: [action] Take 1 damage or 1 horror: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner, place it on top of this location, taking its place.
cards.text_cn: [action]受到1點傷害或1點恐懼：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果抽出的地點左上角帶有對應地點符號，將其放在本地點上方並替代本地點。

cards.name: Templo Mayor
cards.text: Forced - After Templo Mayor enters play: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Serpent]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy here. [reaction] After you defeat or evade a [[Serpent]] enemy at this location: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Group limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在大神廟入場後：將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。從遭遇牌堆頂部棄牌，直到一張[[蛇族]]敵人被棄掉。將該敵人生成於此。 [reaction]你在本地點擊敗或躲避[[蛇族]]敵人後：發現本地點的1個線索。(團隊每階段限制一次。)

cards.name: Templo Mayor
cards.text: Forced - After Templo Mayor enters play: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck. Discard cards from the top of your deck until a weakness is discarded. Draw that weakness. [action] Shuffle a weakness from your discard pile into your deck: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在大神廟入場後：將你的棄牌堆洗回牌堆中。從你的牌堆頂部棄牌，直到一張弱點被棄掉。抽取該弱點。 [action]將你棄牌堆內的1張弱點卡洗回你牌堆中：發現本地點的2個線索。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Temples of Tenochtitlán
cards.text: Forced - After Temples of Tenochtitlán enters play: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct damage. While you are investigating Temples of Tenochtitlán, if you have 3 or fewer remaining health, Temples of Tenochtitlán gets -2 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在特諾奇蒂特蘭神廟入場後：本地點上的每位調查員受到1點直接傷害。 你調查特諾奇蒂特蘭神廟時，如果你生命值少於或等於3，該地點隱藏值-2。

cards.name: Temples of Tenochtitlán
cards.text: Forced - After Temples of Tenochtitlán enters play: Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy. [action] Place 1 doom on an enemy: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在特諾奇蒂特蘭神廟入場後：在最近的敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。 [action]在一個敵人上放置1個毀滅標記：發現本地點的2個線索。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Chapultepec Hill
cards.text: Forced - After Chapultepec Hill enters play: Each investigator at this location discards 2 random cards from his or her hand. [action] Discard your hand of at least 3 cards: Discover 2 clues at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在查普爾特佩克山入場後：本地點上的每位調查員隨機丟棄2張手牌。 [action]丟棄你所有手牌(你有至少3張手牌時方可發動此行動)：發現本地點的2個線索。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Chapultepec Hill
cards.text:
Each investigator at Chapultepec Hill gets -2 [willpower].
[reaction] After you draw a [[Hex]] card: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Group limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn:
位於查普爾特佩克山的每位調查員-2[willpower]。
[reaction]在你抽取一張[[巫術]]卡牌後：發現本地點的1個線索。(團隊每階段限制一次。)

cards.name: Canals of Tenochtitlán
cards.text:
Each enemy at Canals of Tenochtitlán gets +2 evade.
While there is an exhausted enemy at Canals of Tenochtitlán, it gets -3 shroud.
cards.text_cn:
特諾奇蒂特蘭運河上的每個敵人+2躲避。
特諾奇蒂特蘭運河上有處於消耗狀態的敵人時，該地點隱藏值-3。

cards.name: Canals of Tenochtitlán
cards.text: Forced - After Canals of Tenochtitlán enters play: Place 4 resources on it. Canals of Tenochtitlán gets +1 shroud for each resource on it. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 resource from Canals of Tenochtitlán.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在特諾奇蒂特蘭運河入場後：在本地點上放置4資源。 特諾奇蒂特蘭運河上每有一資源，隱藏值+1。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：丟棄特諾奇蒂特蘭運河的1資源。

cards.name: Lake Xochimilco
cards.text: Forced - After Lake Xochimilco enters play: Each investigator at this location loses all of his or her remaining actions. While you are investigating Lake Xochimilco, it gets +2 shroud for each action you have remaining.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在霍奇米爾科湖入場後：本地點上的每位調查員失去其剩餘的所有行動。 你調查霍奇米爾科湖時，你每剩餘1個行動，該地點隱藏值+2。

cards.name: Lake Xochimilco
cards.text: Forced - After Lake Xochimilco enters play: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct horror. While you are investigating Lake Xochimilco, if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity, Lake Xochimilco gets -2 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在霍奇米爾科湖入場後：本地點上的每位調查員受到1點直接恐懼。 你調查霍奇米爾科湖時，如果你神智值少於或等於3，該地點隱藏值-2。

cards.name: Sacred Woods
cards.text: Forced - After Sacred Woods enters play: Each investigator at this location discards the top 10 cards of his or her deck. [action] If you have no cards remaining in your deck: Discover all of the clues at Sacred Woods.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在聖林入場後：本地點上的每位調查員丟棄其牌堆頂的10張卡牌。 [action]如果你牌堆內沒有卡牌剩餘：發現聖林所有的線索。

cards.name: Sacred Woods
cards.text:
While you are at Sacred Woods, increase the cost of each card you play by 2.
While you are investigating Sacred Woods, it gets -1 shroud for each asset you control.
cards.text_cn:
你位於聖林時，你打出每張卡牌的費用+2。
你調查聖林時，你每控制1張支援卡，該地點隱藏值-1。

cards.name: Padma Amrita
cards.text: Alert. Retaliate. Hunter. While Padma Amrita is ready, clues cannot be discovered from each [[Ancient]] location. Forced - After Padma Amrita attacks you: If you have at least 1 clue, flip 1 of your clues to its doom side. Otherwise, take 3 horror.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。反擊。獵手。 只要帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔處於準備狀態，不能發現任何[[古代]]地點的線索。 強制 - 在帕德瑪·阿姆麗塔攻擊你後：如果你至少有1個線索，將你的1個線索翻至毀滅面。否則，受到3點恐懼。

cards.name: Serpent of Tenochtitlán
cards.text: While Serpent of Tenochtitlán is at an [[Ancient]] location with clues on it, it gains retaliate and alert. Otherwise, it gains hunter. Forced - After Serpent of Tenochtitlán deals you damage from its attack: If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
cards.text_cn: 特諾奇蒂特蘭惡蛇位於帶有線索的[[古代]]地點時，它獲得反擊和警戒。否則，它獲得獵手。 強制 - 在特諾奇蒂特蘭惡蛇攻擊並對你造成傷害後：如果你未中毒，將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。

cards.name: Hand of the Brotherhood
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from an [[Ancient]] location, if Hand of the Brotherhood is ready: Place 1 doom on Hand of the Brotherhood. While Hand of the Brotherhood is ready, [action] and [reaction] abilities on its location and connecting locations cannot be triggered.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個無人地點。 強制 - 在一個[[古代]]地點的最後一個線索被發現後，如果兄弟會之手處於準備狀態：將1個毀滅標記放到兄弟會之手上。 兄弟會之手處於準備狀態時，其所在地點和連接地點的[action]和[reaction]能力不能觸發。

cards.name: Window to Another Time
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Choose and shuffle an [[Ancient]] location back into the exploration deck (the [[Present-Day]] location underneath it takes its place). - Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance).
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 選擇並將1個[[古代]]地點洗回探索牌堆(該地點下方的[[現代]]地點替代該地點)。 - 在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果可能導致當前密謀推進)。

cards.name: Timeline Destabilization
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [[Ancient]] location in play. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and shuffle Timeline Destabilization into the exploration deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](1)。場上每有1個[[古代]]地點，本次檢定難度+1。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，將時間線失穩洗入探索牌堆。

cards.name: Relic of Ages
cards.text: [fast] Exhaust Relic of Ages: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remove 1 doom from the current agenda. If you fail, add 1 doom to Relic of Ages. (Max one success per game.)
cards.text_cn: [free]消耗古代遺物：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你成功，移除當前密謀上的1個毀滅標記。如果你失敗，在古代遺物上放置1個毀滅標記。(每場遊戲最多成功1次。)

cards.name: Heart of the Elders
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are in a [[Cave]] location).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
[tablet]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位於[[洞穴]]地點上，改為-3)。
[cultist]：-2。如果你失敗，將1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：-2。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are in a [[Cave]] location).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead. If you are not poisoned and you fail, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, take 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你位於[[洞穴]]地點上，改為-4)。
[cultist]：-3。如果你失敗，放置1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：-3。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。如果你未中毒且檢定失敗，將放在一邊的一張中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Mouth of K'n-yan
cards.text: [action]: Resign. "Let's make camp and solve this puzzle tomorrow." [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a compass, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。"我們搭帳棚吧，明天再解開這個謎團。" [action]：查看你的補給品。如果你有指南針，查看探索牌堆頂部的3張卡牌。按任意順序將1張卡牌放在牌堆底部，其餘2張放在牌堆頂部。

cards.name: The Jungle's Heart
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's lookout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. 
If the lookout has binoculars, he or she is able to see the creature approaching and avoid it. The lookout suffers no ill effects.
If the lookout does not have binoculars, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy at the lookout's location.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
調查員隊長選擇一位調查員來擔任瞭望員。然後，該調查員查看自己的補給品。
如果瞭望員帶有雙筒望遠鏡，就能夠看見有生物逼近並避開它。瞭望員未受負面效果。
如果瞭望員沒有雙筒望遠鏡，從遭遇牌堆頂部棄牌，直到一張敵人卡被丟棄。將該敵人生成在瞭望員所在地點。

cards.name: Setting Sun
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位倖存的調查員立即撤退。

cards.name: Opening the Maw
cards.text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Objective - Solve the puzzle of the six pillars in order to enter K'n-yan. If there are 6 pillar tokens on the Mouth of K'n-yan, advance to act 2b.
cards.text_cn: [action]位於昆揚之口的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：你解開了其中一個謎題。在昆揚之口上放置1個資源，視作1個石柱標記。 目標 - 為了進入昆揚，必須揭開六根石柱的謎題。如果昆揚之口上有6個石柱標記，推進到場景2b。

cards.name: The Lonely Caverns
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你所在地點沒有線索：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時：不要從場上任何地點移除毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
From the entrance far behind you, a threatening hiss and an all-too-familiar rattling causes you to freeze in terror. You grip the nearest weapon you can find and turn in fright, hands trembling. How has it followed you this far? When will this awful hunt end?
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 8 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
cards.back_text_cn:
查看冒險日誌。如果預示者還活著：
洞穴入口已落在你身後遠處，從那兒傳來一陣可怖的嘶嘶聲，伴隨著一陣再熟悉不過的隆隆聲，令你萬分驚恐，動彈不得。你抓起你所能找到的最近的武器，害怕地拐進轉角，雙手瑟瑟發抖。這麼遠，它是怎麼跟著你的？這可怕的追捕什麼時後才結束？
搜索收藏，找出瓦盧西亞的預示者，將它生成在距離所有調查員最遠的地點(如果你冒險日誌裡的"伊格之怒"下方有8次或更多記錄，改為將它生成在調查員隊長所在地點)。按照冒險日誌括號內記錄的傷害總數，瓦盧西亞的預示者在入場時帶有對應數量的傷害。

cards.name: Eyes in the Dark
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你所在地點沒有線索：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。 *本密謀的毀滅目標值+1[per_investigator]。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 倖存的所有調查員被擊敗，並受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: Cavern of the Forgotten Age
cards.back_text: Shuffle Descent to Yoth into the exploration deck. The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. If the scout has chalk, you are able to avoid traveling in circles. The scout suffers no ill effects. If the scout does not have chalk, place 1 clue on each location in play (from the token pool). Then, if the scout is on a single-sided location, shuffle that location back into the exploration deck. Move each enemy and investigator that was at that location to a connecting location nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan.
cards.back_text_cn: 將深入幽嘶洗入探索牌堆。 調查員隊長選擇一位調查員來擔任隊伍的偵查員。然後，該調查員查看自己的補給品。 如果偵查員帶有粉筆，你們得以避免原地繞圈。偵查員未受負面效果。 如果偵查員沒有粉筆，在場上每個地點放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。然後，如果該偵查員位於一個單面地點上，將該地點洗回探索牌堆。將位於該地點的所有敵人和調查員移動到一個離昆揚之口最近的連接地點上。

cards.name: Descent into Dark
cards.text: Objective - If each surviving investigator is at the Descent to Yoth and there is no doom on it, you may advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果每位倖存的調查員均位於深入幽嘶，且該地點上沒有毀滅標記，你可以推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If the investigators rescued Alejandro: (→R1). - If Alejandro is missing: (→R2).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果調查員解救了亞歷山卓：(→結局1) - 如果亞歷山卓已失蹤：(→結局2)

cards.name: Pitfall
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to jump the gap. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. - Shuffle Pitfall into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Pitfall was drawn from the exploration deck.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 檢定[agility](3)來嘗試跳過這條裂隙。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害。 - 將落入陷阱洗入探索牌堆。落入陷阱如果是從探索牌堆抽出的，你不能選擇這個選項。

cards.name: Poisonous Spores
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the attached location who is poisoned takes 2 horror. Each investigator at the attached location who is not poisoned must put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in his or her threat area, instead. Discard Poisonous Spores.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：被疊加地點上的每位已中毒的調查員受到2點恐懼。位於被疊加地點上的每位未中毒的調查員，改為必須將放在一邊的一張中毒弱點卡放置到其威脅區域。丟棄有毒孢子。

cards.name: Time-Wracked Woods
cards.text: [action] [action]: Choose a non-[[Elite]] card worth vengeance points in the victory display. Place that card in the encounter discard pile. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：從勝利牌區選擇一張帶有復仇點數的非[[精英]]卡牌。將該卡牌放到遭遇棄牌堆。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Stone Altar
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Stone Altar: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [elder_sign], [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, lose 1 action. If you cannot, take 1 horror instead.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入石板祭壇後：從混亂袋隨機抽出1個混亂標記。 如果你抽出的是[elder_sign]、[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]標記，失去1個行動。如果你沒有行動可失去，改為受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Apex Strangleweed
cards.text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Apex Strangleweed makes an attack of opportunity against you: Check your supplies. If you do not have a pocket knife, lose all remaining actions and end your turn.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。反擊。 強制 - 在絕命噬藤對你發起趁亂攻擊後：查看你的補給品。如果你沒有折疊小刀，則你失去所有剩餘行動並結束你的回合。

cards.name: Basilisk
cards.text: Prey - Nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan. Hunter. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Shuffle one copy of Basilisk into the encounter deck. (Max once per round.) Vengeance 2.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 距離昆揚之口最近的調查員。 獵手。 強制 - 在1個石柱標記被放置在昆揚之口上後：將1張蛇怪洗入遭遇牌堆。(每輪最多一次。) 復仇2。

cards.name: Ants!
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, discard a random card from your hand or choose and discard a card from your play area.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](4)。你失敗且每低於難度一點，隨機丟棄1張手牌，或選擇並丟棄你遊戲區域內的1張卡牌。

cards.name: Vast Passages
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to explore while at Vast Passages, check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has binoculars, you must spend 1 additional action.
cards.text_cn: 作為你在寬闊步道探索時的額外費用，查看你們的補給品。如果此地點沒有調查員帶有雙筒望遠鏡，你必須額外花費1個行動。

cards.name: Hall of Idolatry
cards.text: Forced - After you put Hall of Idolatry into play by successfully exploring: Check Campaign Log. If there are 5 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury", draw the top card of the encounter deck (top 2 cards instead if there are 10 or more tally marks).
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你探索成功並將崇拜禮堂放置入場後：查看冒險日誌。如果"伊格之怒"下方有至少5次記錄，抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌(如果有至少10次記錄，改為抽取牌堆頂的2張卡牌)。

cards.name: Dark Hollow
cards.text: Forced - After Dark Hollow enters play, check your supplies. If no investigator has a map: Place 1 [per_investigator] additional clues on Dark Hollow.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在漆黑洞窟入場後，查看你們的補給品。如果沒有調查員帶有地圖：在漆黑洞窟上放置1[per_investigator]個額外的線索。

cards.name: Perilous Gulch
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Perilous Gulch: Check your supplies. If no investigator at this location has rope, place 1 doom on Perilous Gulch.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你調查危險峽谷時，技能檢定失敗後：查看你們的補給品。如果本地點上沒有調查員帶有繩索，在危險峽谷上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Crystal Pillars
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Crystal Pillars: Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each vengeance point in the victory display. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入晶體柱群後：檢定[willpower](1)。勝利牌區內每有1點復仇點數，本次檢定難度+1。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害與1點恐懼。

cards.name: Descent to Yoth
cards.text: Forced - After Descent to Yoth enters play: Each investigator must either place 1 doom on Descent to Yoth or draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Descent to Yoth: Instead of discovering clues, you may flip 1 doom on Descent to Yoth to its clue side. Vengeance 2.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在深入幽嘶入場後：每位調查員必須在深入幽嘶上放置1個毀滅標記或抽取遭遇牌堆頂部的2張卡牌。 [reaction]在你成功調查深入幽嘶後：你可以不發現線索，改為將深入幽嘶上的1個毀滅標記翻至其線索面。 復仇2。

cards.name: No Turning Back
cards.text: Revelation - Attach No Turning Back to your location or a connecting location. Limit 1 per location. Investigators cannot enter or leave attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or check your supplies. If you succeed, or if you have a pickaxe, discard No Turning Back. Any investigator at a connecting location may activate this ability.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將無路可退疊加到你所在地點或一個連接地點。每個地點限制1張。 調查員不能進入或離開被疊加的地點。 [action]：檢定[combat](3)或查看你的補給品。如果你成功，或你帶有鶴嘴鋤，丟棄無路可退。位於連接地點的任何調查員都可以啟動此能力。

cards.name: The City of Archives
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 5 or more cards in your hand).
[cultist] or [elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, discard 1 random card from your hand.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你有5張或更多的手牌，改為-3)。
[cultist][elder_thing]：-2。如果你失敗，在你所在地點上放置1個你的線索。
[tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，隨機丟棄1張手牌。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, you automatically fail instead).
[cultist] or [elder_thing]: -2. Place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. For each point you fail by, discard 1 random card from your hand.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你有5張或更多的手牌，改為你自動失敗)。
[cultist][elder_thing]：-2。在你所在地點上放置1個你的線索。
[tablet]：-3。你失敗且每低於難度一點，隨機丟棄1張手牌。

cards.name: City of the Great Race
cards.text: Investigators cannot put [[Item]] assets into play (including [[Item]] weaknesses).
cards.text_cn: 調查員不能將[[道具]]支援卡放置入場(包含[[道具]]弱點卡)。
cards.back_text: Each investigator searches the top 9 cards of his or her deck for up to 2 [[Item]] assets and draws them. Shuffle each searched deck. (Note: Investigators are now able to put [[Item]] assets into play.) Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If The Custodian is in play and not controlled by an investigator, move it to the location with the most clues on it.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員查找自己牌堆頂上的9張卡牌，找出至多2張[[道具]]支援卡並抽取這些卡牌。將查找過的牌堆混洗。(注意：調查員現在就能夠將[[道具]]支援卡放置入場。) 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 如果看管人在場，並且不受調查員控制，將它移動到線索最多的地點上。

cards.name: Lost Memories
cards.text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 2.
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員手牌上限減少2張。
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If The Custodian is in play and not controlled by an investigator, move it to the location with the most clues on it.
Check your supplies. If an investigator has a pendant, that investigator reads the following:
As you spend more and more time in the alien city, your memories of the past continue to fade. Then, a spark of hope returns to you, and you recall an object you once carried with you, one that brought you comfort when times were tough. You sift through the objects the Yithians replicated from your descriptions, and there you find it: a pendant on a silver chain. As you hold it, your real identity comes flooding back.
Each investigator with a pendant draws 2 cards. For the remainder of the scenario, each investigator with a pendant ignores any effect that would reduce his or her maximum hand size.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 如果看管人在場，並且不受調查員控制，將它移動到線索最多的地方。
查看你們的補給品。如果有調查員帶有掛墜，該調查員閱讀以下文本：
隨著你在這座古怪的城市逗留的時間越久，你對於過去的記憶就越模糊。隨即一絲希望的火花回到你的腦海，你回想起你曾攜帶的一件物品，在你困難的時間裡給你帶來慰藉。你仔細查看伊斯根據你的描述複製的物品，在其中找到了那件物品：一個銀質鏈子的掛墜。就當你握緊這掛墜的時候，你真正的身份如潮水一般湧入腦海。
每位帶有掛墜的調查員抽取2張手牌。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，每位帶有掛墜的調查員忽略將會減少手牌上限的任何效果。

cards.name: Humanity Fading
cards.text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員的手牌上限減少4張。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated.
cards.back_text_cn: 倖存的每位調查員被擊敗。

cards.name: Exploring Pnakotus
cards.text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.
cards.text_cn: 每個伊斯觀測者獲得冷漠。
cards.back_text: Put each set-aside location into play (Great Library, Laboratory of the Great Race, Yithian Orrery, Deconstuction Room, and Towers of Pnakotus). Choose one of those locations at random. Put the set-aside The Custodian asset into play at the randomly chosen location. (Note: Each copy of Yithian Observer is no longer aloof.)
cards.back_text_cn: 將所有放在一邊的地點放置入場(大圖書館、偉大種族的實驗室、伊斯的太陽系儀、解構室、納克特之塔)。 隨機從上述地點中選擇1個地點，將放在一邊的看管人支援卡放置入場，放到所選的地點上。(注意：伊斯觀測者不再具有冷漠關鍵詞。)

cards.name: Restricted Access
cards.text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果以下情況中，有三種情況已發生，你必須推進場景： - 有調查員"找到了歸位程式"。 - 有調查員"解剖了一個器官"。 - 有調查員"進行了一次會談"。 - 有調查員"發現了現在的年份"。 - 有調查員"啟動了設備"。 - 有調查員控制了看管人。
cards.back_text: You no longer have to perform any of the following tasks.
