However, the more you have performed by the time the scenario ends, the easier the transition to your human body will be, and the less likely the process is to fail or backfire. Be careful... Place this act in the victory display with this side faceup, as a reminder. - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
cards.back_text_cn: 你再也不必執行以下任何任務。 但是，你在本場冒險結束之前執行的任務越多，就越容易能轉移到你的人類身體中，這項程式失敗或產生反作用的機率也更低。但要當心…… 將本場景放進勝利牌區，以本面朝上放置，作為提醒。 - 有調查員"找到了歸位程式"。 - 有調查員"解剖了一個器官"。 - 有調查員"進行了一次會談"。 - 有調查員"發現了現在的年份"。 - 有調查員"啟動了設備"。 - 有調查員控制了看管人。

cards.name: Repossession
cards.text: Each Yithian Observer gains hunter. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If your hand exceeds your maximum hand size, draw 1 additional card. Objective - If each surviving investigator has 10 or more cards in his or her hand, immediately advance. (Beware - remember to complete as many of the tasks listed on act 2b as you can.)
cards.text_cn: 每個伊斯觀測者獲得獵手。 [action]花費1個線索：抽取。不抽取1張卡牌，改為抽取2張。如果你的手牌超出上限，額外抽取1張卡牌。 目標 - 如果倖存的每位調查員有至少10張手牌，立即推進場景。(注意——記住要盡可能多地完成場景2b上列出的任務。)

cards.name: Body of a Yithian
cards.text:
Each of your [[Ally]] assets gains the [[Yithian]] trait.
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Draw 1 card.
cards.text_cn:
你的每張[[盟友]]支援卡獲得[[伊斯]]屬性。
[reaction]在你將卡牌投入你正在執行的技能檢定後：該卡牌上的技能圖標數量翻倍。(每次檢定限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。抽取1張卡牌。
cards.back_text: Deck Size: What it used to be, when you were human. Deckbuilding Options: Yithians can't build decks. Deckbuilding Requirements: (do not count toward deck size): Do you remember...?
cards.back_text_cn: 卡牌張數：與曾是人類時的卡牌張數一樣。 牌組構建選項：伊斯人不能構建牌組。 牌組構建需求(不計入卡牌張數)：你還記得嗎……？

cards.name: Interview Room
cards.text: [reaction] After you begin your turn in this location, if there is a [[Yithian]] enemy in this location: Draw 1 card.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你在本地點開始自己的回合後，如果本地點有[[伊斯]]敵人：抽取1張卡牌。

cards.name: Interview Room
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) or [combat] (4) to interrogate the captive mind restrained here. If you succeed, remember that you "interviewed a subject." If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](4)或[combat](4)來訊問被居留在此的意識。如果你成功，請記住你"進行了一次會談"。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Interview Room
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (3). Take 1 horror for each point you fail by.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入本地點後：檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Halls of Pnakotus
cards.text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
cards.text_cn: [free]在你回合期間，選擇並丟棄一張手牌：移動到另一張納克特廊道。(每回合限制一次。)

cards.name: Halls of Pnakotus
cards.text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
cards.text_cn: [free]在你回合期間，選擇並丟棄一張手牌：移動到另一張納克特廊道。(每回合限制一次。)

cards.name: Halls of Pnakotus
cards.text: [fast] During your turn, choose and discard a card from your hand: Move to another copy of Halls of Pnakotus. (Limit once per turn.)
cards.text_cn: [free]在你回合期間，選擇並丟棄一張手牌：移動到另一張納克特廊道。(每回合限制一次。)

cards.name: Great Library
cards.text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Test [intellect] (3) to decipher the information you've found. If you succeed, remember that you have "found the process." Forced - At the end of the round, if there are fewer than 4 clues on Great Library: Add clues to Great Library until there are 4 clues on it.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費1[per_investigator]個線索：檢定[intellect](3)來破譯你找到的信息。如果你成功，請記住你"找到了歸位程式"。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果大圖書館上不足4個線索：在大圖書館上放置線索，直到其上有4個線索。

cards.name: Yithian Orrery
cards.text:
[action] [action] If there are no clues on Yithian Orrery: Remember that you "realized what year it is."
While you are in the Yithian Orrery, increase your maximum hand size by 2.
cards.text_cn:
[action][action]如果伊斯的太陽系儀上沒有線索：請記住你"發現了現在的年份"。
你位於伊斯的太陽系儀時，你手牌上限提高2張。

cards.name: Laboratory of the Great Race
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on Laboratory of the Great Race: Test [agility] (3) to manipulate the controls on the technological device nearby. If you succeed, remember that you "activated the device." If you fail, place 1 clue on Laboratory of the Great Race (from the token pool).
cards.text_cn: [action]如果偉大種族的實驗室上沒有線索：檢定[agility](3)來操縱附近的先進設備。如果你成功，請記住你"啟動了設備"。如果你失敗，將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到偉大種族的實驗室上。

cards.name: Deconstruction Room
cards.text: [action]: Test [combat] (4) to attempt to retrieve a valuable organ from one of the alien cadavers. This test gets +1 difficulty for each clue on Deconstruction Room. If you succeed, remember that you "dissected an organ."
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[combat](4)來試圖從其中一具怪物屍體中取出寶貴的器官。解構室上每有1個線索，本次檢定難度+1。如果你成功，請記住你"解剖了一個器官"。

cards.name: Towers of Pnakotus
cards.text: [action]: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw cards equal to 1 more than the number of cards you discarded. (Limit once per turn.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：丟棄你任意張手牌。將你的棄牌堆洗回你牌堆中，再抽取卡牌，抽取的張數等於你棄掉的手牌數+1。(每回合限制一次。)

cards.name: The Custodian
cards.text: [reaction] When the investigation phase begins, if you control The Custodian: Each investigator at its location draws 1 card. [action] If The Custodian is not controlled by a player: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to converse with the library custodian. If you succeed, something about its mannerisms seems familiar to you; place 1 of your clues on it. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on it, take control of The Custodian.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在調查階段開始時，如果你控制著看管人：位於其所在地點的每位調查員抽取1張卡牌。 [action]如果看管人不受玩家控制：談判。檢定[intellect](3)來與圖書館看管人交涉。如果你成功，你對它的某些怪異行徑感到熟悉；在本卡牌上方放置你的1個線索。然後，如果本卡牌上有1[per_investigator]個線索，控制看管人。

cards.name: Keeper of the Great Library
cards.text: Spawn - Great Library. Alert. Aloof. If an investigator has "found the process" or "realized what year it is," Keeper of the Great Library loses aloof and gains hunter.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 大圖書館。 警戒。冷漠。 如果有調查員"找到了歸位程式"或"發現了現在的年份"，大圖書館的監守人失去冷漠並獲得獵手。

cards.name: Scientist of Yith
cards.text: Spawn - Laboratory of the Great Race. Aloof. If an investigator has "activated the device" or "dissected an organ," Scientist of Yith loses aloof and gains hunter.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 偉大種族的實驗室。 冷漠。 如果有調查員"啟動了設備"或"解剖了一個器官"，伊斯科學家失去冷漠並獲得獵手。

cards.name: Scholar from Yith
cards.text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Forced - When Scholar from Yith attacks you: Discard 2 random cards from your hand. [action] If Scholar from Yith is ready and engaged with you: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to attempt to pass as a member of the creature's race. If you succeed, draw 1 card and evade Scholar from Yith. If you fail, Scholar from Yith attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 手牌最多的調查員。 強制 - 在伊斯學者攻擊你時：隨機丟棄你2張手牌。 [action]如果伊斯學者處於準備狀態且與你交戰：談判。檢定[intellect](3)來嘗試扮作偉大種族的一員。如果你成功，抽取1張卡牌並躲避伊斯學者。如果你失敗，伊斯學者攻擊你。

cards.name: Yithian Presence
cards.text: Revelation - Put Yithian Presence into play in your threat area. If there is a [[Yithian]] enemy at your location, you cannot investigate that location or trigger [action] abilities on encounter cards (including this card). [action] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: Discard Yithian Presence.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將伊斯人登場放置到你的威脅區域。 如果你所在地點有[[伊斯]]敵人，你不能調查該地點或觸發遭遇卡上的[action]能力(包括本卡牌)。 [action]選擇並丟棄2張手牌：丟棄伊斯人登場。

cards.name: Cruel Interrogations
cards.text: Revelation - Put Cruel Interrogations into play in your threat area. If any investigator has "interviewed a subject," take 1 horror and Cruel Interrogations gains surge. You cannot take draw actions. [action]: Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, discard Cruel Interrogations.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將殘酷拷問放置到你的威脅區域。如果有調查員"進行了一次會談"，受到1點恐懼，並且殘酷拷問獲得湧動。 你不能執行抽牌行動。 [action]：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你成功，丟棄殘酷拷問。

cards.name: Lost Humanity
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, remove the top card of your deck from the game. If there are less than 10 total cards in your hand, deck and discard pile, you are driven insane.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。你失敗且每低於難度一點，將你牌堆頂部的1張卡牌移出遊戲。如果你手牌、牌堆和棄牌堆的卡牌總數少於10張，則你發瘋。

cards.name: Captive Mind
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (0). Regardless of whether this skill test succeeds or fails, choose and discard all but X cards from your hand. X is your modified skill value for this test.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](0)。不管本次技能檢定是成功還是失敗，選擇並將你的手牌棄至X張。其中X為你本次檢定的修正後的技能值。

cards.name: Out of Body Experience
cards.text: Revelation - Shuffle each card from your hand into your deck and draw an equal number of cards. Shuffle Out of Body Experience into your deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將你所有手牌洗入你的牌堆，再抽取相同數量的卡牌。將離體體驗洗入你的牌堆。

cards.name: The Depths of Yoth
cards.text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -X. X is the current depth level. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location or a connecting location heals 2 damage. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 clue on your location (from the token pool). [elder_thing]: -2. If there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you automatically fail this test, instead.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-X。其中X為當前深度等級。 [cultist]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，在你所在地點或連接地點的每個[[蛇族]]敵人治癒2點傷害。 [tablet]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，在你所在地點放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-2。如果勝利牌區內有3點或更多的復仇點數時，改為你本次檢定自動失敗。
cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X. X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 1 horror. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, each [[Serpent]] enemy at your location or a connecting location heals 2 damage. [tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 clue on your location (from the token pool). [elder_thing]: -4. If there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you automatically fail this test, instead.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-X。其中X為當前深度等級。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。 [cultist]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，在你所在地點或連接地點的每個[[蛇族]]敵人治癒2點傷害。 [tablet]：再抽一個標記。如果你失敗，在你所在地點放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果勝利牌區內有3點或更多的復仇點數時，改為你本次檢定自動失敗。

cards.name: The Descent Begins
cards.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
cards.back_text_cn: 找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。

cards.name: Horrific Descent
cards.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Check your supplies. If an investigator has a canteen, that investigator must decide: - This could be useful. Remember that you have "collected a strange liquid." - I'm not going anywhere near that.You suffer no ill effects.
cards.back_text_cn: 找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。 查看你們的補給品。如果有調查員帶有水壺，該調查員必須決定： - 這可能有用。請記住你"收集了一種奇怪的液體"。 - 我不會靠近它半步。你未受負面效果。

cards.name: Endless Caverns
cards.back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies.
If the scout has rope, he or she is able to climb up with ease, and the investigators suffer no ill effects. 
If the scout does not have rope, he or she must test [combat] or [agility] (5). If the performing investigator fails, he or she makes it to the top but suffers 1 physical trauma from the exhaustion of the climb.
cards.back_text_cn:
找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。
調查員隊長選擇一位調查員擔任隊伍的偵查員。然後，該調查員查看自己的補給品。
如果偵查員有繩索，則他可以輕鬆爬上石崖，調查員未受負面效果。
如果偵查員沒有繩索，則他必須檢定[combat]或[agility](5)。如果執行檢定的調查員失敗，他成功爬上石崖，但在攀爬過程中耗盡氣力，他受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: City of Blood
cards.back_text:
If the Harbinger of Valusia is set aside, move it to the pursuit area.
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果瓦盧西亞的預示者被放在一邊，將它移動到追擊區域。
找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。

cards.name: Fury That Shakes the Earth
cards.text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本密謀上放置了第3個毀滅標記後：找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。
cards.back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
If Yig is set aside:
The ground shakes with each of the massive creature's steps. He crushes the stone beneath his mighty feet, tearing through walls with his clawed, scaly hands. He sets his hateful eyes on you, unhinging his jaw in a cruel display of hunger.
Spawn Yig in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
cards.back_text_cn:
找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。
如果伊格被放在一邊：
地面伴隨著這頭龐大生物的每一個腳步而震動搖晃。他有力的腳掌踩裂腳下每方石塊，用長滿鱗片、帶有指甲的雙手撕開牆壁。他對你投來憎恨的目光，殘忍地露出飢餓的神情，下頷大張。
將伊格生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。

cards.name: The Red Depths
cards.text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在有毀滅標記被放置到當前密謀上後：找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。
cards.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Until the end of the scenario, the current agenda gains: "Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on the current agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level." Place this card in the pursuit area with this side faceup, as a reminder.
cards.back_text_cn: 找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。 在本場冒險結束之前，當前密謀獲得："強制 - 在有毀滅標記被放置到當前密謀上後：找出躲避值最高且處於追擊中的敵人，將它生成在本深度等級開始時調查員所在的地點上。" 將本卡牌放進追擊區域，以本面朝上放置，作為提醒。

cards.name: VENGEANCE
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當神話階段"檢查毀滅標記目標值"步驟結束時：場上每有1個毀滅標記，調查員按照玩家順序抽取額外1張遭遇卡。 目標 - 如果所有調查員被擊敗，推進本密謀。

cards.name: Journey to the Nexus
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess the requisite number of clues, they may advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth will be defeated.)
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你所在地點沒有線索：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。 目標 - 當一輪結束時，如果位於幽嘶的階梯的多位調查員共有所需數量的線索，他們可以推進場景。(注意：不位於幽嘶的階梯的所有調查員將被擊敗。)
cards.back_text: Add 1 resource to the current depth level. If the current depth level is 5+ and you are playing in Campaign Mode, go to (→R2). Otherwise, perform the following: - Each investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth is left behind and is defeated. Each surviving investigator loses each of his or her clues. - Move each enemy in play to the pursuit area. - Remove all doom from locations in play. Set each location in play and in the exploration deck aside, out of play. Investigators are not defeated during this process. - Draw a random set-aside location other than Steps of Yoth, put it into play, and place each surviving investigator at that location. - Create a new exploration deck consisting of Steps of Yoth and 4 other random set-aside locations. Shuffle the exploration deck. - Flip this act back over. Journey as deep as you can…
cards.back_text_cn: 增加1資源到當前深度等級。如果當前深度等級為5或以上，且你以劇本模式進行遊戲，進入(→結局2)。 否則，按照以下步驟執行： - 不位於幽嘶的階梯的每位調查員被遺棄且被擊敗。每位倖存的調查員失去自己的所有線索。 - 將場上所有敵人移動到追擊區域。 - 移除場上地點上的所有毀滅標記。將場上和探索牌堆的所有地點放在一邊，位於場外。調查員此進程期間不被擊敗。 - 隨機抽取一張放在一邊的、除幽嘶的階梯以外的地點，將它放置入場，將每位倖存的調查員放置在該地點。 - 從放在一邊的地點中拿出幽嘶的階梯，再從中隨機抽取4張地點，以此5張地點創建一個新的探索牌堆。混洗探索牌堆。 - 將本場景翻面。盡你所能，向更深處探險……

cards.name: Steps of Yoth
cards.text: [reaction] When adding to the current depth level, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess 5 [per_investigator] clues as a group, an investigator at Steps of Yoth crosses rope off from his or her supplies: Add 1 additional resource to the current depth level. (Max once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在增加當前深度等級時，如果位於幽嘶的階梯的調查員以團隊為單位共有5[per_investigator]個線索，幽嘶的階梯上的一位調查員可以從自己的補給品劃掉繩索：增加額外的1資源到當前深度等級。(每場遊戲最多一次。)

cards.name: City of the Serpents
cards.text: While City of the Serpents has no clues on it, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
cards.text_cn: 只要萬蛇之城沒有線索，該地點被視為在勝利牌區中(計入復仇點數)。

cards.name: Hall of Heresy
cards.text: While an investigator is in Hall of Heresy, it is considered to be in the victory display (for the purposes of counting vengeance).
cards.text_cn: 只要有調查員位於異端教堂，該地點被視為在勝利牌區中(計入復仇點數)。

cards.name: Crumbling Precipice
cards.text: Forced - When you attempt to explore while at Crumbling Precipice: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, test [agility] (3). If you fail, test [combat] (2). If you fail, you fall to your death and are killed. (If you succeed at any of these tests, you explore as usual.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於岌岌可危的懸崖並試圖探索時：檢定[willpower](4)。如果你失敗，檢定[agility](3)。如果你失敗，檢定[combat](2)。如果你失敗，你墜入深淵，陣亡。(如果你通過以上任一檢定，你正常探索。)

cards.name: Caverns of Yoth
cards.text: Forced - After Caverns of Yoth enters play: Place clues on it equal to the current depth level.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在幽嘶洞群入場後：在該地點上放置線索，數量等於當前深度等級。

cards.name: Forked Path
cards.text: Forced - When you explore while at Forked Path, check your supplies. If you have a map: Continue drawing cards from the exploration deck until you have drawn 2 connecting locations, if able. Put both of those locations into play and choose 1 to move to.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於分岔路並試圖探索時，查看你的補給品。如果你帶有地圖：繼續從探索牌堆抽牌，直到你抽出2張連接地點(如果可以的話)。將這2個地點放置入場，選擇其中1個地點並移動到該地點上。

cards.name: Bridge over N'kai
cards.text: Bridge over N'kai gets +1 shroud for each vengeance point in the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 勝利牌區內每有1點復仇點數，橫跨恩凱之橋+1隱藏值。

cards.name: Broken Passage
cards.text: Forced - When you explore while at Broken Passage, check your supplies. If you do not have a pickaxe: Place 1 doom on Broken Passage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於坍塌的通道並試圖探索時，查看你的補給品。如果你沒有鶴嘴鋤：將1個毀滅標記放到坍塌的通道。

cards.name: Abandoned Site
cards.text: X is the current depth level.
cards.text_cn: X為當前深度等級。

cards.name: Bright Canyon
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Bright Canyon, if you are poisoned: Take 1 damage. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have binoculars, discover 2 clues on Bright Canyon. (Group limit once each depth level.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入光耀峽谷後，如果你已中毒：受到1點傷害。 [action]：查看你的補給品。如果你帶有雙筒望遠鏡，發現光耀峽谷的2個線索。(團隊每深度等級限制一次。)

cards.name: Yig
cards.text:
Hunter. Massive.
Yig gets +6 [per_investigator] health.
Yig cannot be damaged while there is another ready [[Serpent]] enemy at its location.
Each other [[Serpent]] enemy at Yig's location gains alert and retaliate.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。龐大。
伊格獲得+6[per_investigator]生命值。
當所在地點上有另一個準備狀態的[[蛇族]]敵人時，伊格不會受到傷害。
伊格所在地點上的其他每個[[蛇族]]敵人獲得警戒和反擊。

cards.name: Pit Warden
cards.text: Spawn - If Yig is in play, spawn Pit Warden at Yig's location. Otherwise, place Pit Warden in the pursuit area. Hunter.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 如果伊格在場，將深坑守衛生成在伊格所在地點。否則，將深坑守衛放置在追擊區域。 獵手。

cards.name: Eater of the Depths
cards.text: Spawn - Put a random set-aside location into play and spawn Eater of the Depths there. Hunter. Massive. X is the current depth level.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 將隨機一個放在一邊的地點放置入場，並在該地點生成深淵吞噬者。 獵手。龐大。 X為當前深度等級。

cards.name: Children of Valusia
cards.text: Revelation - Put Children of Valusia into play next to the agenda deck. Each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Children of Valusia from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將瓦盧西亞之子放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 每個[[蛇族]]敵人+1攻擊，+1躲避。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張瓦盧西亞之子。(每輪最多一次。)

cards.name: Lightless Shadow
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](1)。本次檢定難度+X，其中X為當前深度等級。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Bathophobia
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current depth level. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](1)。本次檢定難度+X，其中X為當前深度等級。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Serpent's Ire
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Serpent]] enemies in pursuit, Serpent's Ire gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Serpent]] enemy in pursuit with the highest fight value and spawn it engaged with you. If an enemy is spawned by this effect, test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, that enemy immediately attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果沒有[[蛇族]]敵人處於追擊中，蛇族的憤怒獲得湧動。否則，找出擁有最高攻擊值且處於追擊中的[[蛇族]]敵人，它生成並與你交戰。如果有敵人在本效果作用下生成，檢定[agility](X)，其中X為該敵人的攻擊值。如果你失敗，該敵人立即攻擊你。

cards.name: Relic of Ages
cards.text: [fast] Exhaust Relic of Ages: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, remove 1 doom from any card in play. (Max one success per game.)
cards.text_cn: [free]消耗古代遺物：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你成功，移除場上任意卡牌上的1個毀滅標記。(每場遊戲最多成功一次。)

cards.name: Shattered Aeons
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if the Relic of Ages is at your location).
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
[tablet]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, shuffle the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-2(如果古代遺物位於你所在地點，改為-4)。
[cultist]：-2。如果你未成功並超過難度至少1點，在最近的[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。
[tablet]：-2。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你失敗，將遭遇棄牌堆頂上的第一張[[巫術]]詭計卡洗入探索牌堆。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -3 (-5 instead if the Relic of Ages is at your location).
[cultist]: -3. If you do not succeed by at least 1, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead. If you are not poisoned and you fail, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
[elder_thing]: -3. Shuffle the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-3(如果古代遺物位於你所在地點，改為-5)。
[cultist]：-3。如果你未成功並超過難度至少1點，在每個[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。
[tablet]：-3。如果你已中毒，本檢定改為自動失敗。如果你未中毒且檢定失敗，將放在一邊的中毒弱點卡放置到你的威脅區域。
[elder_thing]：-3。將遭遇棄牌堆頂上的第一張[[巫術]]詭計卡洗入探索牌堆。

cards.name: Threads of Time
cards.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果一位手牌、牌堆、棄牌堆或遊戲區域內帶有古代遺物的調查員退場：立即推進到密謀3b。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Spawn the set-aside Formless Spawn in the Nexus of N'kai. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 將放在一邊的無形之子生成在恩凱聯結點。 將本卡牌放進勝利牌區。本卡牌獲得復仇1。

cards.name: Pendulous Threads
cards.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果一位手牌、牌堆、棄牌堆或遊戲區域內帶有古代遺物的調查員退場：立即推進到密謀3b。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If Formless Spawn is in play, place 2 doom on the Nexus of N'kai. If Formless Spawn is in the victory display, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 如果無形之子在場，在恩凱聯結點上放置2個毀滅標記。如果無形之子位於勝利牌區，將它洗回遭遇牌堆。 將本卡牌放進勝利牌區。本卡牌獲得復仇1。

cards.name: Snapped Threads
cards.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果一位手牌、牌堆、棄牌堆或遊戲區域內帶有古代遺物的調查員退場：立即推進到密謀3b。

cards.name: Worlds Beyond
cards.text: Forced - When an enemy would spawn at an empty location and there are no empty locations in play: Reveal cards from the exploration deck until a location is revealed. Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there. Shuffle the exploration deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人將生成在一個無人地點，且場上沒有無人地點時：從探索牌堆翻開卡牌，直到翻開一個地點。將該地點放置入場，並將該敵人生成在該地點。混洗探索牌堆。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside A Pocket in Time location into the exploration deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的時間之窗地點洗入探索牌堆。

cards.name: Search for the Brotherhood
cards.text: Objective - If an investigator enters A Pocket in Time, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果有調查員進入時間之窗，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside [[Shattered]] locations into the exploration deck. Each investigator shuffles the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck. Check Campaign Log. - If the relic is missing, attach the set-aside Relic of Ages (Unleash the Timestream) to A Pocket in Time, under no investigator's control. Advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic." - If the investigators found the missing relic, advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic."
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的[[破碎]]地點洗入探索牌堆。每位調查員將遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的一張[[巫術]]詭計卡洗入探索牌堆。 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果遺物已丟失，將放在一邊的古代遺物(時光湧流)疊加到時間之窗，不受調查員控制。推進到場景3a - "伊斯人的遺物"。 - 如果調查員找回了丟失的遺物，推進到場景3a - "伊斯人的遺物"。

cards.name: The Yithian Relic
cards.text: [action]: Search your deck or discard pile for the Relic of Ages and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. [action] If the Relic of Ages is attached to your location and there are no clues on that location: Take control of the Relic of Ages. Objective - If an investigator controls the Relic of Ages, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]：查找你的牌堆和棄牌堆，找出古代遺物並將它加入手牌。混洗你的牌堆。 [action]如果古代遺物疊加到你所在地點，且該地點上沒有線索：取得古代遺物的控制權。 目標 - 如果有調查員控制古代遺物，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
For the remainder of the scenario, if the Relic of Ages leaves play for any reason, shuffle each location attached to it into the exploration deck and reset the act deck to act 3a.
Check Campaign Log. If Ichtaca is set against you:
The thing that was once your companion slithers out of the darkness, hissing. "Yig will have his way! Valusia will be returned to us!"
Spawn the set-aside Ichtaca (Scion of Yig) in the Nexus of N'kai.
If Alejandro is set against you:
"Fools! Are you blind?" Alejandro motions to the worlds before him. "Your kind stands no chance against the ravages of time."
Spawn the set-aside Alejandro (Or, Is He?) in A Pocket in Time.
cards.back_text_cn:
在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，如果古代遺物出於任何原因而離場，將它疊加的每個地點洗回探索牌堆，將場景牌堆重置為場景3a。
查看冒險日誌。如果伊塔卡與你為敵：
某物從黑暗中滑行著身軀，口中嘶嘶有聲，它曾經是你的同伴。"伊格將會找到辦法！瓦盧西亞即將再臨於我族！"
將放在一邊的伊塔卡(伊格的後裔)生成於恩凱聯結點上。
如果亞歷山卓與你為敵：
"蠢貨！你沒長眼睛嗎？"亞歷山卓指著他面前的各個世界，"你的種族是沒法敵過時間的蹂躪的。"
將放在一邊的亞歷山卓(或許不是他？)生成在時間之窗。

cards.name: Mend the Shatter
cards.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If the number of locations attached to the Relic of Ages is equal to 1 plus the number of investigators who started the game, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你在[[破碎]]地點，且該地點沒有線索：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你成功，將你所在地點正面朝下疊加到古代遺物。該地點的每位調查員和每個敵人均被移動到時間之窗。 目標 - 如果疊加到古代遺物的地點數為遊戲開始時的調查員人數+1，推進場景。
cards.back_text: - If Relic of Ages (Repossess the Past) is the version of the Relic of Ages that the investigators control, proceed to (→R5). - If the investigators control any other version of the Relic of Ages, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn: - 如果調查員所控制的古代遺物版本是古代遺物(重拾往昔)，進入(→結局5)。 - 如果調查員所控制的是古代遺物的任何其他版本，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Paradise Lost
cards.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Valusia is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你在[[破碎]]地點，且該地點沒有線索：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你成功，將你所在地點正面朝下疊加到古代遺物。該地點的每位調查員和每個敵人均被移動到時間之窗。 目標 - 如果瓦盧西亞被疊加到古代遺物，推進場景。

cards.name: Timelock
cards.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Pnakotus is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你在[[破碎]]地點，且該地點沒有線索：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你成功，將你所在地點正面朝下疊加到古代遺物。該地點的每位調查員和每個敵人均被移動到時間之窗。 目標 - 如果納克特被疊加到古代遺物，推進場景。

cards.name: Nexus of N'kai
cards.text: Forced - After you move from Nexus of N'kai to an [[Otherworld]] location, or vice versa: Take 1 horror for each clue on that [[Otherworld]] location. [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Do not take horror from the above Forced ability when moving via this effect.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你從恩凱聯結點移動到一個[[異界]]地點，或從一個[[異界]]地點移動到恩凱聯結點後：該[[異界]]地點上每有1個線索，受到1點恐懼。 [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。在本效果作用下移動時，不從上述強制能力中受到恐懼。

cards.name: Yig's Mercy
cards.text:
Check Campaign Log. If there are 16 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury": Ichtaca refuses your plea. Flip this card back over. If there are 15 or fewer tally marks:
Ichtaca ceases her assault and listens to your words. "Valusia must be returned to glory. There is no other way," she decrees with bitter certainty. "Help us to achieve this goal, and you can join with us. Yig will remake you in his image, and we shall live together in our timeless paradise of Valusia."
The investigators must decide (choose one): - "I could never turn my back on humanity!" Flip this card back over, exhausted and unengaged. For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Ichtaca. - "I accept." Remove this card and Act 4a - "Mend the Shatter" from the game and advance to the set-aside Act 4a - "Paradise Lost". For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Alejandro Vela, and [[Serpent]] enemies do not engage or attack you.
cards.text_cn:
查看冒險日誌。如果在"伊格之怒"下方有大於或等於16次記錄： 伊塔卡拒絕了。將本卡牌翻面。 如果在"伊格之怒"下方有小於或等於15次記錄：
伊塔卡停下了攻擊，傾聽你的話語。"瓦盧西亞必須重獲榮光。必須這麼做。"她堅定地說，"幫我們達成這個目標，而後你就可以加入我們。伊格將會把你重塑成他的模樣，我們將一同生活在永恆的天堂，瓦盧西亞。"
調查員必須作出決定(以下一項)： - "我永遠都不會背叛人類！"將本卡牌翻面，其被消耗且不處於交戰狀態。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，你不能與伊塔卡談判。 - "我答應你。"將本卡牌和場景4a - "修補裂痕"移出遊戲，並推進到放在一邊的場景4a - "失樂園"。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，你不能與亞歷山卓·維拉談判，並且[[蛇族]]敵人不會與你交戰或攻擊你。

cards.name: Another Way
cards.text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - "I could never turn my back on humanity!" Flip this card back over, exhausted and unengaged. For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Alejandro Vela. - "I accept." Remove this card and Act 4 - "Mend the Shatter" from the game and advance to the set-aside Act 4a - "Timelock". For the remainder of the scenario, you cannot parley with Ichtaca, and [[Cultist]] enemies do not engage or attack you.
cards.text_cn: 調查員必須作出決定(以下一項)： - "我永遠都不會背叛人類！"將本卡牌翻面，其被消耗且不處於交戰狀態。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，你不能與亞歷山卓·維拉談判。 - "我答應你。"將本卡牌和場景4a - "修補裂痕"移出遊戲，並推進到放在一邊的場景4a - "鎖定時間"。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，你不能與伊塔卡談判，並且[[異教徒]]敵人不會與你交戰或攻擊你。

cards.name: Yuggoth
cards.text: [action]: Flip a clue on Yuggoth to its doom side. Draw 1 card.
cards.text_cn: [action]：將猶格斯星上的1個線索翻面至毀滅面朝上。抽取1張卡牌。

cards.name: Shores of R'lyeh
cards.text: Shores of R'lyeh gets +1 shroud for each doom on each card in Shores of R'lyeh (including itself). Forced - After Shores of R'lyeh enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
cards.text_cn: 拉萊耶海岸的每張卡牌(包括其本身)上每有1個毀滅標記，+1隱藏值。 強制 - 在拉萊耶海岸入場後：在該地點上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: City of the Unseen
cards.text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy at City of the Unseen: Place 1 additional doom on that enemy.
cards.text_cn: 強制 -在隱匿之城的一個[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個或多個毀滅標記後：在該敵人身上放置1個額外的毀滅標記。

cards.name: A Pocket in Time
cards.text: Forced - After you move from A Pocket in Time to a [[Shattered]] location, or vice versa: Take 1 damage for each clue on that [[Shattered]] location. [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Do not take damage from the above Forced ability when moving via this effect.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你從時間之窗移動到一個[[破碎]]地點，或從一個[[破碎]]地點移動到時間之窗後：[[破碎]]地點上每有一個線索，受到1點傷害。 [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。在本效果作用下移動時，不從上述強制能力中受到傷害。

cards.name: Ruins of New York
cards.text: Forced - After Ruins of New York enters play: Put the top card of the lead investigator's deck into play at this location, facedown (2 cards instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Treat each of those cards as Flying Polyp enemies with 2 fight, 2 health, 2 evade, 1 damage, and the [[Monster]] trait.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在紐約遺址入場後：將調查員隊長牌堆頂的1張卡牌放置入場，正面朝下放在本地點上(如果本局遊戲有3或4位調查員，改為放置2張卡牌)。將這些卡牌視作飛天水螅敵人，帶有2點攻擊、2點生命、2點躲避、1點傷害，具有[[怪物]]屬性。

cards.name: Mu
cards.text: While you are at Mu, the first [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol you reveal during each skill test gains: "Reveal another token."
cards.text_cn: 你位於姆大陸時，你在每次技能檢定期間抽出的第一個[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]標記獲得："再抽一個標記。"

cards.name: Atlantis
cards.text: Forced - After an [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during a skill test at any location: Place 1 doom on Atlantis. Then, if there are 3 or more doom on Atlantis, remove it from the game. Each enemy and investigator that was at Atlantis is defeated.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你在任何地點上執行技能檢定期間，在抽出[auto_fail]標記後：在亞特蘭蒂斯上放置1個毀滅標記。然後，如果亞特蘭蒂斯上有3個或更多的毀滅標記，將它移出遊戲。位於亞特蘭蒂斯的所有敵人和調查員均被擊敗。

cards.name: Pnakotus
cards.text: [action] If there are at least 3 [tablet] tokens in the chaos bag or sealed on cards in play: Discover all of the clues on Pnakotus and draw that many cards. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]如果至少有3個[tablet]標記在混亂袋中，或被封印在場上的卡牌上：發現納克特的所有線索，並抽取等量的卡牌。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Valusia
cards.text: [action] If there are at least 3 [cultist] tokens in the chaos bag or sealed on cards in play: Heal 2 damage and 2 horror. Set Valusia's shroud to 0 for the remainder of the game. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]如果至少有3個[cultist]標記在混亂袋中，或被封印在場上的卡牌上：治癒2點傷害和2點恐懼。直到本局遊戲結束之前，將瓦盧西亞的隱藏值設為0。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Plateau of Leng
cards.text: Forced - If you reveal an [elder_thing] symbol during a skill test at Plateau of Leng: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果你在冷原上執行技能檢定期間抽出[elder_thing]標記：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Formless Spawn
cards.text: Spawn - Nexus of N'kai. Massive. Formless Spawn cannot move or be moved. Formless Spawn gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each doom on each card in Nexus of N'kai (including Nexus of N'Kai).
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 恩凱聯結點。 龐大。無形之子不能移動，也不能被移動。 位於恩凱聯結點的每張卡牌上(包括恩凱聯結點)每有1個毀滅標記，無形之子+1攻擊並+1躲避。

cards.name: Temporal Devourer
cards.text: Spawn - Farthest [[Shattered]] or [[Extradimensional]] location. If there are no such locations in play, Temporal Devourer gains surge. Hunter. Forced - After Temporal Devourer enters a [[Shattered]] or [[Extradimensional]] location: Place 1 clue on that location (from the token pool).
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最遠的[[破碎]]或[[異次元]]地點。如果場上沒有此類地點，時間吞噬者獲得湧動。 獵手。 強制 - 在時間吞噬者進入[[破碎]]或[[異次元]]地點後：將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到該地點。

cards.name: Shattered Ages
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on each location other than Nexus of N'kai.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。如果你失敗，在除恩凱聯結點以外的每個地點上放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。

cards.name: Between Worlds
cards.text: Revelation - Put Between Worlds into play as an [[Otherworld]] location with 3 shroud and 1 clue, and move to it. It is connected to the Nexus of N'kai. (If drawn from the exploration deck, this exploration is still considered unsuccessful.) Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator here takes 1 damage and 1 horror. If there are no investigators in this location, discard it and move each enemy here to Nexus of N'kai.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將異界之間放置入場，作為一個[[異界]]地點，具有3隱藏值和1個線索，然後移動到該地點。該地點與恩凱聯結點相連。(如果從探索牌堆抽出本卡牌，本次探索仍視為失敗。) 強制 - 當一輪結束時：每位位於本地點的調查員受到1點傷害與1點恐懼。如果本地點上沒有調查員，將該地點棄掉並將該地點上的所有敵人移動到恩凱聯結點。

cards.name: Wracked by Time
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Each investigator at a [[Shattered]] location must also perform this skill test. Each investigator who fails takes 2 damage. Each asset assigned damage by this effect that is not defeated is shuffled into its owner's deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。在[[破碎]]地點上的每位調查員必須都執行本技能檢定。每位失敗的調查員受到2點傷害。支援卡如被分配本效果產生的傷害，且未被擊敗，則該支援卡被洗入其所有者的牌堆。

cards.name: Creeping Darkness
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to Nexus of N'kai. Place 1 doom on Creeping Darkness. Formless Spawn gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] [action]: Test [willpower] (3) or check your supplies. If you succeed, or if you have torches, Discard Creeping Shadows.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到恩凱聯結點。在黑暗隱伏上放置1個毀滅標記。 無形之子+1[per_investigator]生命。 [action][action]：檢定[willpower](3)或查看你的補給品。如果你成功，或你帶有火把，丟棄黑暗隱伏。

cards.name: Relic of Ages
cards.text: Forced - After you resolve a treachery while exploring: Shuffle that treachery back into the exploration deck instead of discarding it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你探索時結算一張詭計卡後：不將該詭計卡棄掉，改為將其洗回探索牌堆。

cards.name: Turn Back Time
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X . X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為帶有毀滅標記的地點數。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你失敗，將1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X . X is the total amount of doom on locations.
[elder_thing]: -6. Place 1 doom on your location.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為地點帶有的毀滅標記總數。
[elder_thing]：-6。將1個毀滅標記放到你所在地點。

cards.name: Into the Ruins Once Again
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的時間石室地點洗入探索牌堆。 將本場景放進勝利牌區。本場景獲得復仇2。

cards.name: The Chamber of Still Remains
cards.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是一個連接地點，放置入場並移動到該地點。 目標 - 只有在時間石室的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Search the collection for Yig (The Forgotten Age card #296). Spawn it in the Chamber of Time. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇位於時間石室的一位調查員來控制古代遺物。 搜索收藏找出伊格(失落的時代#296)。將它生成在時間石室。 將本場景放進勝利牌區。本場景獲得復仇2。

cards.name: Moment of Doom
cards.text: Relic of Ages gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, flip a clue controlled by an investigator at your location to its doom side, and place it on your location. Then, deal 3 damage to Yig." Objective - If Yig is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: 古代遺物獲得："[action]：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你成功，將你所在地點的一位調查員的一個線索翻面至毀滅面朝上，並且將它放在你所在地點上。然後，對伊格造成3點傷害。" 目標 - 如果伊格被擊敗，推進場景。
